schemes.brief: جو ہندوستانی اروناچل پردیش کا رہائشی نہیں ہے، اسے ریاست میں داخل ہونے کے لیے اِنر لائن پرمٹ چاہیے۔ پہلے اس کے لیے لائزن آفس میں قطار لگانی پڑتی تھی؛ اب e-ILP پورٹل ایک دو دن میں آن لائن پرمٹ دے دیتا ہے، اور چیک گیٹ پر پرمٹ فون پر دکھایا جاتا ہے۔
schemes.benefit: آن لائن جاری ہونے والا اِنر لائن پرمٹ، جو آپ کے مانگے ہوئے دنوں اور ضلعوں کے لیے کارآمد ہے
eligibility: ہندوستانی شہری جو اروناچل پردیش کا مستقل رہائشی نہیں ہے
عارضی پرمٹ گھومنے کے لیے ہے؛ ریگولر پرمٹ کام یا لمبے قیام کے لیے ہے اور اس کے لیے اسپانسر چاہیے
ہر شخص کا ایک پرمٹ؛ ماں یا باپ کے ساتھ سفر کرنے والے بچے اسی پرمٹ میں جوڑے جاتے ہیں
غیر ملکی شہریوں کو اس کے بجائے پروٹیکٹڈ ایریا پرمٹ چاہیے، یہ نہیں
documents: فوٹو والی شناخت کے طور پر آدھار کارڈ، ووٹر کارڈ یا پاسپورٹ
حال کی پاسپورٹ سائز تصویر
سفر کی تفصیل — کن ضلعوں میں جائیں گے اور کن تاریخوں میں
اسپانسر کی تفصیل، کام کے لیے ریگولر پرمٹ میں
گاڑی کا رجسٹریشن نمبر، اگر آپ اپنی گاڑی سے جا رہے ہیں

demoFields.label: پرمٹ کی قسم
demoFields.hint: گھومنے کے لیے عارضی، کام یا لمبے قیام کے لیے ریگولر۔ ریگولر پرمٹ کے لیے ریاست میں کوئی اسپانسر چاہیے۔

demoFields.label: درخواست دہندہ کا نام (جیسا فوٹو ID پر ہے)
demoFields.hint: بالکل ویسا جیسا آپ کے اپ لوڈ کیے شناختی کاغذ پر ہے۔ چیک گیٹ پر دونوں ملائے جاتے ہیں۔

demoFields.label: فوٹو شناخت کی قسم اور نمبر
demoFields.hint: آدھار، ووٹر کارڈ یا پاسپورٹ۔ وہی کاغذ اپنے ساتھ رکھیں، کیونکہ گیٹ پر اس کی جانچ ہوتی ہے۔

demoFields.label: جن ضلعوں میں جانا ہے
demoFields.hint: اپنے راستے کے ہر ضلع کا نام لکھیں۔ پرمٹ صرف ان ضلعوں کے لیے کارآمد ہے جو اس پر لکھے ہیں، باقی کے لیے گیٹ سے واپس بھیج دیا جاتا ہے۔

demoFields.label: سفر کی تاریخیں
demoFields.hint: کب سے کب تک۔ پلان سے دو ایک دن زیادہ مانگیں — ریاست کے اندر پہنچ کر پرمٹ بڑھوانا ابھی صحیح بنوانے سے زیادہ مشکل ہے۔

demoFields.label: سفر کا مقصد
demoFields.hint: سیاحت، کاروبار، کام، یا رشتے داروں سے ملنا۔ کام کا مقصد لکھنے پر یہ ریگولر پرمٹ بن جاتا ہے جس کے لیے اسپانسر چاہیے۔

demoFields.label: آپ کے ساتھ سفر کرنے والے لوگ
demoFields.hint: ماں یا باپ کے ساتھ سفر کرنے والے بچے اسی پرمٹ پر جاتے ہیں۔ ہر بالغ کو اپنا الگ پرمٹ چاہیے۔

demoFields.label: گاڑی کا رجسٹریشن نمبر
demoFields.hint: اگر آپ اپنی گاڑی سے جا رہے ہیں تو بھریں۔ گیٹ پر پرمٹ کے ساتھ اس کی بھی جانچ ہوتی ہے۔

demoFields.label: موبائل نمبر اور ای میل
demoFields.hint: پرمٹ یہیں ڈاؤن لوڈ والی فائل کی شکل میں آتا ہے۔ نکلنے سے پہلے اسے اپنے فون میں محفوظ کر لیں — راستے میں نیٹ ورک کمزور ہوتا ہے۔

demoSteps: سفر سے کم سے کم کچھ دن پہلے eilp.arunachal.gov.in پر درخواست دیں۔ زیادہ تر عارضی پرمٹ ایک یا دو کام کے دنوں میں مل جاتے ہیں۔
فارم بھریں، اور اپنے راستے کے ہر ضلع کا نام لکھیں۔ جس ضلع کا نام پرمٹ پر نہیں ہوگا، اس کے گیٹ سے آپ آگے نہیں جا سکیں گے۔
اپنی فوٹو والی شناخت اور فوٹو اپ لوڈ کریں، فیس آن لائن ادا کریں اور درخواست نمبر لکھ لیں۔
منظوری کے میسج کا انتظار کریں، پھر پرمٹ ڈاؤن لوڈ کر کے اپنے فون میں محفوظ کر لیں۔ ایک کاپی پرنٹ بھی کر لیں، کیونکہ پہاڑوں میں نیٹ ورک کا بھروسہ نہیں۔
وہی شناختی کاغذ ساتھ رکھیں جو آپ نے اپ لوڈ کیا تھا۔ چیک گیٹ پر پرمٹ اور وہ کاغذ ملا کر دیکھے جاتے ہیں۔
اگر زیادہ دن رکنا ہو یا کسی ایسے ضلع میں جانا ہو جو پرمٹ پر نہیں ہے، تو پرمٹ کی مدت ختم ہونے سے پہلے ایکسٹینشن کے لیے درخواست دیں، بعد میں نہیں۔
schemes.helpline: جس ضلع میں آپ جا رہے ہیں، اس کے ڈپٹی کمشنر کا دفتر

schemes.title: Ayushman Asom – Mukhya Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AA-MMJAY Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: Atal Amrit Abhiyan Society, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Assam
schemes.brief: Free, cashless hospital treatment of up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family at empanelled government and private hospitals in Assam. It covers about 26 lakh NFSA ration card families who are not on the Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY list, with the same treatment packages. It replaced the older Atal Amrit Abhiyan health card, which was merged into it in 2023. The card is made by Aadhaar e-KYC, done by ASHA workers and other frontline staff at home or at camps.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at over 300 empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Families listed in Assam's NFSA (ration card) database who are not already covered by Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
Of about 56 lakh NFSA families, about 30 lakh are under PM-JAY and the other 26 lakh under AA-MMJAY
Every member named on the ration card is covered. There is no limit on family size or age
All PM-JAY treatment packages are included: 1,949 procedures in 27 specialities
Government employees and pensioners are not covered here; they have the separate AA-MMLSAY scheme
documents: NFSA ration card of the family
Aadhaar card of each member who needs a card
Mobile number (if it is linked to Aadhaar, OTP e-KYC is quicker)
A live photo, taken during e-KYC
schemes.submitAt: There is no paper form. Ask your ASHA worker, MPW, Bima Sakhi or Digipay Sakhi to do the AA-MMJAY e-KYC at your home or at the village camp. You can also go to the Ayushman desk (Arogya Mitra) of any empanelled hospital, the district kiosk at the medical college or civil hospital, or a Common Service Centre. Take the NFSA ration card, the Aadhaar card of each member and your mobile phone. Each member must be present for Aadhaar OTP or face authentication.

demoFields.label: کس سے تلاش کریں
demoFields.hint: The operator can search by ration card, Aadhaar or name. The ration card finds the whole family at once.

demoFields.label: راشن کارڈ نمبر
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the NFSA ration card. If nothing is found, try the head of family's Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Scheme shown
demoFields.hint: The list shows whether your family is under PM-JAY or AA-MMJAY. Both give the same Rs.5 lakh cover.

demoFields.label: Member selected
demoFields.hint: Each member is done one by one. Pick the person who is sitting with the operator.

demoFields.label: e-KYC کے لیے آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: The Aadhaar of this member. Children need their own Aadhaar too.

demoFields.label: e-KYC کا طریقہ
demoFields.hint: Use OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar; otherwise face authentication or fingerprint.

demoFields.label: لائیو فوٹو
demoFields.hint: Face straight, good light, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the card rejected.

demoFields.label: موبائل نمبر
demoFields.hint: Any working number in the family. Approval messages come here.

demoFields.label: خاندان کے سربراہ سے رشتہ
demoFields.hint: How this person is related to the first name on the ration card.

demoFields.label: ضلع اور PIN کوڈ
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so nearby empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Check whether your family is on the list by asking your ASHA worker or calling 14555 with the ration card number. NFSA families not under PM-JAY fall under AA-MMJAY.
Get the e-KYC done by the ASHA, MPW, Bima Sakhi or Digipay Sakhi at home or at a camp, or at the Ayushman desk of an empanelled hospital or the district kiosk.
The operator finds your family, verifies each member with Aadhaar OTP or a face scan, and takes a live photo.
The request goes to the Atal Amrit Abhiyan Society for approval. Once approved, the operator gives you the Ayushman card.
When you need treatment, go to the Arogya Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital with the card or Aadhaar. The hospital takes approval before treatment, and you pay nothing for a listed procedure.
If a hospital asks for money or refuses the card, call 1800-103-9975 or 14555.
schemes.helpline: 1800-103-9975 — Atal Amrit Abhiyan toll-free (PM-JAY and MMJAY) / 14555 — national Ayushman helpline / 0361-2333603 — Atal Amrit Abhiyan Society office, Guwahati

schemes.title: Orunodoi 3.0 (Orunodoi Scheme)
schemes.department: Finance (Institutional Finance) Department, Government of Assam
schemes.brief: Assam's monthly cash support for poor families, paid straight into the bank account of one woman the family nominates. It pays Rs.1,250 a month to about 37 to 40 lakh families, and for October 2026 alone the government raised it to Rs.1,500 for the Puja season. Orunodoi 3.0 replaced the earlier versions 1.0 and 2.0, so every family, old beneficiaries included, had to apply afresh. Names are first picked at the Gaon Panchayat, VCDC or ward level, and the family needs an Aadhaar-seeded NFSA ration card.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,250 a month by DBT to the woman of the family (Rs.1,500 for October 2026)
eligibility: Permanent resident of Assam who lives in the state now
The family holds an NFSA ration card seeded with Aadhaar, and its income is within the NFSA limit of the Assam Food Security Rules
The family nominates one woman aged 18 or above. The money goes only to her own Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Priority for widows, divorced or separated women, unmarried women above 45, families with a divyang or transgender member, and families living with thalassemia, HIV or leprosy
Not for families with a serving or retired government or PSU employee, a current or former MP or MLA, a current panchayat or municipal member, or an income-tax payer
Also left out: families of doctors, engineers, lawyers and chartered accountants, families owning a motorised four-wheeler, and landholders above the small and marginal farmer category
documents: NFSA ration card of the family, seeded with Aadhaar
Aadhaar card of the nominated woman
Passbook of her own bank account, seeded with Aadhaar (payments are now made through the Aadhaar-based payment system)
Mobile number, preferably the one linked to her Aadhaar
Voter ID card
Proof for a priority category, if any: husband's death certificate, divorce papers, or disability (UDID) certificate
Signed undertaking on the eligibility conditions, filled at the Gaon Panchayat or ward office
schemes.submitAt: Your Gaon Panchayat office (the VCDC office in Sixth Schedule areas, or the ward or municipal office in towns), when the government opens a round for new names. The form is free there, and the Orunodoi Sarothi of your Assembly constituency helps you fill it. Go with the nominated woman and take the Aadhaar-seeded ration card, her Aadhaar card, her Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook, a mobile phone, and any widow, divorce or disability papers. Get a signed acknowledgement slip. There is no online application, so do not pay anyone who offers to apply online for you.

demoFields.label: Name of the nominated woman
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on her Aadhaar card and in her bank account. The money goes only to her.

demoFields.label: Husband's / father's name
demoFields.hint: Write the husband's name if she is married, otherwise the father's name.

demoFields.label: Gaon Panchayat / VCDC / Town
demoFields.hint: In a town, write the municipality or town committee name instead.

demoFields.label: Village / Ward number and district
demoFields.hint: The village or ward where the family actually lives and eats together.

demoFields.label: NFSA ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the ration card. Her name should be on this card.

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: The nominated woman's 12-digit Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: بینک اکاؤنٹ نمبر اور IFSC
demoFields.hint: Her own account, seeded with Aadhaar. A joint account or someone else's account will be rejected.

demoFields.label: موبائل نمبر
demoFields.hint: SMS about wrong bank details or approval comes to this number.

demoFields.label: Priority category
demoFields.hint: Tick widow, divorced, separated, unmarried above 45, divyang or transgender member if it applies, and attach the proof.

demoFields.label: Number of members on the ration card
demoFields.hint: Count everyone listed on the ration card. Only one woman per family can get Orunodoi.

demoSteps: Watch for a new Orunodoi round announced in the newspapers, on the Gaon Panchayat notice board or by your Orunodoi Sarothi. Women already getting the money do not need to apply again unless they are asked to.
Collect the free form at the Gaon Panchayat, VCDC or ward office. Fill it with the nominated woman's details, attach the copies, sign the undertaking and keep the acknowledgement slip.
The Gaon Panchayat, VCDC or town body checks each family against the eligibility checklist. The District Level Monitoring Committee under the Deputy Commissioner then finalises the list.
The approved list is published and the Finance Department checks the bank details. If an SMS says your details are wrong, correct them at the Gaon Panchayat or ward office.
Rs.1,250 then arrives in her bank account every month by DBT. Keep the account seeded with Aadhaar, or the payment is held back.
If the money stops or the name is missing, call the Orunodoi helpdesk on 1800-202-6256 (working days, 10 am to 6 pm) or meet the Orunodoi Sarothi.
schemes.helpline: 1800-202-6256 — Orunodoi 3.0 helpdesk, Finance Department, Assam (working days, 10 am to 6 pm)

schemes.title: سیوا سیتو — آسام کے سرٹیفکیٹ اور عوامی سروسز
schemes.department: ایڈمنسٹریٹو ریفارمز، ٹریننگ، پنشن اور پبلک گریوینسز ڈپارٹمنٹ، حکومت آسام
schemes.brief: سیوا سیتو وہ ایک جگہ ہے جہاں آسام کا رہائشی کسی سرٹیفکیٹ یا محکمے کی سروس کے لیے درخواست دیتا ہے۔ اس میں کئی محکموں کی 307 سروسز ہیں — انکم، ذات اور پرمانینٹ ریزیڈنس سرٹیفکیٹ، زمین اور ریونیو کا کام، ٹریڈ لائسنس، ایمپلائمنٹ ایکسچینج رجسٹریشن اور اسکیموں کی درخواستیں۔ اس نے پرانے RTPS آسام پورٹل کی جگہ لے لی ہے، جو اب صرف پیچھے سے لاگ اِن اور اپیل چلاتا ہے۔ آسام رائٹ ٹو پبلک سروسز ایکٹ کے تحت نوٹیفائیڈ سروسز میں افسر کے فیصلے کے لیے دن مقرر ہیں، اور گنتی اسی لمحے شروع ہو جاتی ہے جب آپ فارم جمع کرتے ہیں۔
schemes.benefit: ایک ہی موبائل OTP لاگ اِن پر آسام حکومت کی 307 سروسز، ہر ایک کی مدت قانون سے طے
eligibility: آسام کا رہائشی، جو اسی ضلع اور ریونیو سرکل میں درخواست دے جہاں وہ اصل میں رہتا ہے
پرمانینٹ ریزیڈنس سرٹیفکیٹ: آپ یا آپ کا خاندان لگاتار آسام میں رہا ہو اور اس کے ثبوت میں زمین، اسکول یا ووٹر کا ریکارڈ دکھا سکے
ذات سرٹیفکیٹ: آپ کی برادری آسام کی نوٹیفائیڈ SC، ST (میدانی)، ST (پہاڑی) یا OBC/MOBC فہرست میں ہو، اور دعوے کو آپ کے والد کے ریکارڈ سے جانچا جاتا ہے
انکم سرٹیفکیٹ: رقم پورے خاندان کی مالی سال کی ہر ذریعے سے آمدنی ہوتی ہے، صرف تنخواہ نہیں
ایسا موبائل نمبر جو آپ کے پاس رہے، کیونکہ رجسٹریشن، ہر اسٹیٹس میسج اور اپیل سب اسی نمبر پر OTP سے چلتے ہیں
زیادہ تر سرٹیفکیٹ کی کوئی فیس نہیں؛ جہاں کسی سروس کی فیس ہے، وہاں رقم پیمنٹ سے پہلے دکھائی جاتی ہے
documents: درخواست دینے والے کا آدھار کارڈ
آسام کے پتے کا ثبوت — ووٹر ID، راشن کارڈ، بجلی کا بل یا گاؤں پنچایت کا سرٹیفکیٹ
تاریخ پیدائش کا ثبوت — اسکول سرٹیفکیٹ، پیدائش کا سرٹیفکیٹ یا PAN
والد یا دادا کا ذات سرٹیفکیٹ، زمین کا کاغذ یا 1951 کے NRC/ووٹر لسٹ کا اندراج، ذات یا رہائش کے سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے
آمدنی کا ثبوت — سیلری سرٹیفکیٹ، فارم 16، یا گاؤں بوڑا / وارڈ ممبر کا انکم اسٹیٹمنٹ
زمین کا کاغذ (جمابندی یا پٹہ)، اگر سروس ریونیو سے جڑی ہو
حالیہ پاسپورٹ سائز فوٹو، اسکین کی ہوئی
اسکین کیا ہوا دستخط

demoFields.value: انکم سرٹیفکیٹ جاری کرنا (ریونیو اینڈ ڈیزاسٹر مینجمنٹ)
demoFields.hint: پہلے سروس کو نام سے تلاش کریں۔ 307 سروسز میں سے ہر ایک کا اپنا فارم، اپنی کاغذات کی فہرست اور اپنی مدت ہے، اس لیے غلط سروس چنی تو دوبارہ شروع کرنا پڑے گا۔

demoFields.hint: جیسا آدھار پر ہے۔ ذات یا رہائش کے سرٹیفکیٹ میں افسر دعوے کو والد کے ریکارڈ سے جانچتا ہے، اس لیے یہ آپ کے اپ لوڈ کیے کاغذ سے ملنا چاہیے۔

demoFields.hint: جیسی اس اسکول سرٹیفکیٹ یا پیدائش کے سرٹیفکیٹ پر ہے جو آپ اپ لوڈ کر رہے ہیں، یادداشت سے نہیں۔

فارم جمع کریں اور ایکنالجمنٹ نمبر لکھ لیں۔ اسے سنبھال کر رکھیں — بعد میں دفتر میں آپ جو بھی پوچھیں گے، اس کا جواب اسی نمبر سے ملے گا۔

کیس کی جانچ پہلے گاؤں پنچایت یا وارڈ کی سطح پر اور پھر ضلع دفتر کے سوشل ویلفیئر سیکشن میں ہوتی ہے۔ کوئی گھر آ سکتا ہے یا فون کر سکتا ہے، یہ پکا کرنے کے لیے کہ آپ وہیں رہتے ہیں اور کوئی دوسری پنشن نہیں لے رہے۔

پیسہ سیدھے ٹرانسفر سے آدھار سے جڑے بینک اکاؤنٹ میں آنا شروع ہو جاتا ہے۔ اگر کسی مہینے پیسہ نہ آئے تو پہلے بینک میں پوچھیں کہ آدھار جوڑنے میں کوئی خرابی تو نہیں، پھر منظوری کا آرڈر اور ایکنالجمنٹ نمبر لے کر اپنے ڈسٹرکٹ کمشنر کے دفتر کے سوشل ویلفیئر سیکشن جائیں۔

schemes.title: Mukhya Mantrir Nijut Moina Aasoni (Nijut Moina)
schemes.department: Directorate of Higher Education, Higher Education Department, Government of Assam
schemes.brief: A monthly allowance for girl students in Assam, paid for 10 months a year so that girls keep studying instead of being married off early. A girl in Class 11 or 12 gets Rs.1,000 a month, a degree student Rs.1,250 and a postgraduate or B.Ed student Rs.2,500, whatever the family income. Now in its second phase (Nijut Moina 2.0), it opens every August: the college gives out the form, and the student then submits an online application on the Samarth student portal (degree and PG) or the AHSEC DARPAN portal (Class 11 and 12).
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,000 (HS), Rs.1,250 (degree) or Rs.2,500 (PG and B.Ed) a month for 10 months a year
eligibility: Girl students domiciled in Assam, whatever the family income
Studying in HS 1st or 2nd year, a degree course, PG or B.Ed in a government or provincialised institution. Girls in polytechnic courses are covered from 2026-27
She must be unmarried. Married girls are allowed only in PG and B.Ed courses
Not for daughters of Ministers, MPs or MLAs, or for in-service teachers sent to B.Ed on deputation
HS and degree girls who take the Dr. Banikanta Kakati merit scooter cannot get it (they may give up the scooter instead), nor can PG students on the CM's Jibon Prerona scheme
She must have sat the final exam of the previous year and keep regular attendance and discipline
documents: طالب علم کا آدھار کارڈ
Passbook of her own bank account, seeded with Aadhaar and enabled for Aadhaar-based payment
Mobile number linked to her Aadhaar, for the OTP
Admission receipt or college or school identity card
Signed undertaking, declaration and Aadhaar consent form, signed by the student and a parent
حال کی پاسپورٹ سائز تصویر
Samarth enrolment number (degree and PG) or DARPAN login (HS), from the college
Mark sheet of the last examination, where the college asks for it

demoFields.hint: Type it twice. Ask the bank to confirm the account is seeded with Aadhaar for DBT.

demoFields.hint: Most students have no PAN. Just tick the box and carry on.

demoFields.hint: Choose your level: Undergraduate, Postgraduate or B.Ed. Only regular courses qualify.

demoFields.hint: If you took the merit scooter, you cannot get Nijut Moina (except in PG and B.Ed).

demoSteps: In early August, collect the free Nijut Moina form at your college or HS school office (in 2026-27 the forms were given out from 7 August). Fill it, sign the undertaking with a parent, and hand it in with copies of your Aadhaar and bank passbook. University students get it signed by the Head of Department.
The college checks the form and adds your enrolment number to the Nijut Moina scheme on the Samarth portal.

Open assamshesp.samarth.edu.in and log in with your Samarth enrolment number, password and captcha (first time: click Register and set a password using the email OTP). HS students log in at darpan.ahseconline.in instead, update the profile and verify with Aadhaar.
Click Scholarship, then Apply on the Nijut Moina line. Enter the Aadhaar-seeded bank details, address and last exam, upload the passbook, tick the declarations and click Save & Next.
Check every detail, click Submit and verify with the Aadhaar OTP. Print the acknowledgement and give it to the college before the closing date (5 September in 2026).
The college verifies the applications. Once approved, the money comes to your bank account by DBT every month for 10 months. Missing the exam, indiscipline or getting married stops it.
schemes.helpline: No dedicated helpline. First ask the Nijut Moina counter or nodal officer at your college; then the Directorate of Higher Education, Kahilipara, Guwahati-19 (directorhigherassam123@gmail.com)

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana (Jeevika Didi Rs 10,000)
schemes.department: Rural Development Department, Government of Bihar, through JEEViKA (Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society); Urban Development & Housing Department in towns
schemes.brief: Bihar gives one woman in every family Rs 10,000 to start work of her own choice, such as a small shop, tailoring, a beauty parlour, an e-rickshaw, or goat, poultry or cow rearing. She must be a member of a JEEViKA self-help group, or join one; in villages the form is handed in at the JEEViKA village organisation (Gram Sangathan), which approves it and sends it up for payment. Once the work has started it is reviewed, and further help of up to Rs 2 lakh is given in stages. The second instalment of Rs 20,000 is being paid in 2026 to women whose first Rs 10,000 was checked and found properly used.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10,000 first instalment, then up to Rs 2 lakh more after review
eligibility: One woman per family. A family means husband, wife and their unmarried children; an unmarried adult woman whose parents have both died counts as a family of her own
Aged 18 to 60 years and living in Bihar
A member of a JEEViKA self-help group. A woman outside a group can join one by giving a self-declaration at the Gram Sangathan along with her application
Neither the woman nor her husband pays income tax
Neither the woman nor her husband is in government service, whether regular or contract
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman
Bank passbook of a working savings account in her own name, linked to her Aadhaar
موبائل نمبر
Name of her JEEViKA self-help group and Gram Sangathan
پاسپورٹ سائز فوٹو
Self-declaration form (Annexure-2), only if she is not yet in a self-help group
schemes.submitAt: In a village: at the meeting or office of your JEEViKA Mahila Gram Sangathan (village organisation). schemes.title: Diesel Anudan Yojana (Bihar Diesel Subsidy for Irrigation)
schemes.department: Agriculture Department, Government of Bihar (Directorate of Agriculture)
schemes.brief: When the monsoon fails and farmers have to water kharif crops with diesel pump sets, Bihar pays back part of the diesel cost: Rs 75 a litre, counted as Rs 750 an acre for each watering. Farmers registered on the DBT Agriculture portal upload the computerised petrol-pump receipt and apply online, and the money goes to their Aadhaar-linked bank account. The 2026-27 kharif round was ordered on 10 August 2026 and covers the districts the state named as short of rain; each year the list of districts is shown on the application page.
schemes.benefit: Rs 750 an acre per watering, up to Rs 2,250 an acre, for up to 8 acres
eligibility: Registered on the DBT Agriculture portal with a 13-digit number, and a bank account linked to Aadhaar and NPCI
Owner farmers, sharecroppers (bataidar), or both, in villages or towns of the covered districts
Paddy nursery and jute: up to 2 waterings (Rs 1,500 an acre). Standing paddy, maize, pulses, oilseeds, vegetables and medicinal plants: up to 3 waterings (Rs 2,250 an acre)
Diesel bought for irrigation from a registered petrol pump in Bihar, between the start date and the last date of the scheme
One applicant per family (husband, wife and minor children), for at most 8 acres; the least paid is Rs 100
documents: 13-digit DBT Agriculture registration number
Computerised or digital receipt from the petrol pump, with the last 10 digits of your registration number written on it and your signature or thumb mark
For owner farmers: rent receipt (lagan rasid) or LPC issued in 2023-24, 2024-25 or 2025-26
For sharecroppers: the prescribed form signed jointly by a ward member, mukhiya, sarpanch or panchayat samiti member and the Krishi Samanvayak
Thana, khata and khesra numbers of the field watered, and the names of two neighbouring farmers
Mobile number registered on the portal, for the OTP

demoSteps: If you have no 13-digit number yet, register once on dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in under Kisan Panjikaran, free at the block agriculture office or for a small fee at a CSC.

After the scheme opens, buy diesel for irrigation from a registered pump in Bihar. Ask for a computerised receipt, have the last 10 digits of your registration number written on it, and sign it with your full name.

Open the diesel subsidy (kharif) application on the portal or on the Bihar Krishi app, enter the 13-digit number, choose the crop and farmer type, and fill in the field details, the area watered and which watering it is.
Upload the receipt and land papers, enter the captcha and the OTP and submit. Keep the application number from the SMS, and make a fresh application for each watering.
The Krishi Samanvayak checks the claim, and the block and district agriculture officers approve it.
The subsidy is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account by DBT. Use the Diesel Subsidy Status link on the portal to follow it.

schemes.title: Krishi Input Anudan Yojana (Bihar DBT Kisan Registration)
schemes.department: Agriculture Department, Government of Bihar (Directorate of Agriculture)
schemes.brief: When floods, heavy rain, drought or hail destroy more than a third of a crop, Bihar pays farmers in the notified panchayats an input subsidy for each hectare lost, straight into the bank. To get this, or any other farm subsidy such as diesel, seed or machines, a farmer first registers once on the DBT Agriculture portal and gets a 13-digit registration number. The latest round, for crops lost in the floods of August and September 2026, took applications in October 2026; a new round opens after each notified disaster, usually for about a week.
schemes.benefit: Rs 8,500 a hectare (rain-fed), Rs 17,000 (irrigated), Rs 22,500 (perennial crops), up to 2 hectares
eligibility: Your land is in a panchayat notified as affected for that round; the list of panchayats is published on the portal
More than 33 per cent of the crop was lost because of the notified flood, heavy rain, drought or hail
Registered on the DBT Agriculture portal, with a bank account linked to Aadhaar and NPCI
Landowners, tenant or sharecropping farmers (vastavik khetihar), or both may apply, but only one person is paid for one field
One application per family (husband, wife and minor children), paid for at most 2 hectares (494 decimal); the least paid is Rs 1,000, Rs 2,000 or Rs 2,500 depending on the land type
A farmer found burning straw (parali) in the field is refused
documents: Aadhaar card, checked by OTP, fingerprint or iris during registration
Bank passbook of an account linked to Aadhaar and NPCI
Mobile number registered on the portal, for the OTP
For landowners: rent receipt (lagan rasid) of 2023-24, 2024-25 or 2025-26, or a recent LPC; a family tree (vanshavali) is not accepted
For tenant farmers: the self-declaration form certified jointly by the ward member, mukhiya or sarpanch and the Krishi Samanvayak
Thana, khata and khesra numbers of the damaged field and the names of two neighbouring farmers

demoSteps: Register once: open dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in, click Kisan Panjikaran, verify your Aadhaar, fill in your farmer, land and bank details and note the 13-digit registration number. The block agriculture office (e-Kisan Bhawan) does it free; a CSC or Vasudha Kendra can also do it.
After a flood or drought, check the panchayat list on the portal. If your panchayat is listed, open Krishi Input Anudan under online services within the dates shown, usually about a week.

Enter the 13-digit number, choose your farmer type, fill in the total and damaged land in decimal, the thana-khata-khesra numbers and two neighbours' names, enter the captcha and the OTP, upload the rent receipt, LPC or certified self-declaration, and submit. The application number comes by SMS.

The Krishi Samanvayak visits the field within 2 to 4 days, photographs the plot and forwards or rejects the claim with a reason. The sub-divisional and district agriculture officers and the district disaster officer then approve it.
The approved amount is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account by DBT and an SMS tells you. Use Print and Status on the portal with your registration number to follow it.

schemes.title: Bihar Building Workers Registration (BOCW Labour Card)
schemes.department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar
schemes.brief: Masons, labourers, carpenters, painters, plumbers and other construction workers who register with the Bihar BOCW Welfare Board get a labour card that opens more than a dozen benefits: Rs 50,000 for a daughter's marriage, maternity and paternity money, a bicycle grant, help with children's studies, Rs 3,000 a year for medical costs, a Rs 1,000 monthly pension at 60, and Rs 2 to 4 lakh to the family if the worker dies. Registration is done online with Aadhaar on the board's portal, or at a CSC or the block labour office. The fee is small: Rs 20 for registration plus the membership fee, Rs 50 in all for five years.
schemes.benefit: Marriage help Rs 50,000, pension Rs 1,000 a month, death help Rs 2 to 4 lakh, and more
eligibility: Aged 18 to 60 years
Worked at least 90 days in building or other construction work in the last 12 months
The 90 days are certified by the employer or contractor, the Labour Enforcement Officer, a registered trade union officer, or your own self-declaration
Not registered with any other labour welfare board
Most benefits need some time as a member: 1 year for maternity, bicycle and study help; 3 years for marriage help and house repair; 5 years for the pension
Keep the membership renewed; benefits stop while it has lapsed

demoSteps: Open bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in, click Labour Registration, enter your Aadhaar number and name and authenticate with the OTP. If your mobile is not linked to Aadhaar, a CSC or the block Labour Enforcement Officer can do it with your fingerprint.
Verify your mobile number with OTP and fill in your personal details: area, district, mother's name, marital status, category, education and ration card number.
Add the employers you worked for in the last 12 months (at least 90 days in all), choose the certifying authority and upload the certificate or self-declaration.
Add family members and choose a nominee with a share, upload your photo, pay the fee online, then Preview and Submit. Note the application number.

The Labour Enforcement Officer checks and approves the application, and the registration number comes by SMS. Log in with that number and your year of birth to download the labour card and fee receipt.

To claim a benefit later, log in as Labour, choose the scheme, fill in the details and upload the proof (marriage card, birth certificate, mark sheet and so on). Approved money comes to your bank account. Renew the membership before it runs out.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana Bihar (Ayushman Card for Ration Card Holders)
schemes.department: Bihar Swasthya Suraksha Samiti, Health Department, Government of Bihar, with the National Health Authority
schemes.brief: Bihar pays for the same free hospital cover of Rs 5 lakh a year as Ayushman Bharat for ration-card families that the central PM-JAY list left out. Since 2024 every family holding an NFSA ration card in Bihar is covered, either under PM-JAY or under this state scheme, and both use the same Ayushman card at any empanelled hospital. The card is made free with the ration card and Aadhaar, on the Ayushman app or website, at a CSC, or at camps held at ration shops.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
eligibility: The family holds a Bihar ration card under the National Food Security Act (priority household or Antyodaya)
Families already on the central PM-JAY list are covered by PM-JAY; the other ration-card families are covered by this state scheme, with the same card
Every member named on the ration card is covered, with no limit on family size or age
Illnesses you already have are covered from the first day
Each member needs his or her own card, made after Aadhaar e-KYC
documents: Ration card (NFSA); the family is searched by the ration card number
Aadhaar card of each member whose card is being made
OTP کے لیے موبائل نمبر
e-KYC کے دوران فون پر کھینچی گئی لائیو فوٹو

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app, log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP, and choose the state Bihar.
Search by your ration card number. All members on the card appear; if your family is not found, search by Aadhaar.
Pick the member whose card is pending, complete Aadhaar OTP or face e-KYC, take the live photo, add the relation, district and PIN code, and submit.

Bihar Swasthya Suraksha Samiti approves the request, usually within a day or two. Log in again and download the card. You can also get it made free at a CSC, a government hospital or a camp at your ration shop.
At the hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk with the card and Aadhaar. Empanelled hospitals are listed at hospitals.pmjay.gov.in. Never pay cash for a treatment covered by the scheme.

schemes.brief: بہار میں ذات (جاتی)، آمدنی (آے)، رہائش (آواسیہ) اور EWS سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے ایک ہی جگہ، ساتھ میں زمین، راشن کارڈ اور سوشل سیکیورٹی کی سروسز بھی۔ ہندی اور انگریزی میں۔ بہار رائٹ ٹو پبلک سروس ایکٹ ہر سروس کے لیے ایک مقررہ مدت طے کرتا ہے اور مدت گزر جانے پر آپ کو اپیل کا حق دیتا ہے، اور یہ سرٹیفکیٹ مفت بنتے ہیں۔ آپ خود درخواست دے سکتے ہیں، یا اپنے بلاک (پرکھنڈ) آفس کے RTPS کاؤنٹر یا کسی بھی وسودھا کیندر (CSC) پر جا سکتے ہیں — گاؤں میں زیادہ تر درخواستیں اسی طرح دی جاتی ہیں۔

eligibility: بہار کے رہنے والے ہوں، اور اسی بلاک یا سرکل میں درخواست دیں جہاں آپ رہتے ہیں

demoSteps: سیلف ڈکلیریشن (گھوشنا پتر) بھریں۔ پورٹل سے فارمیٹ ڈاؤن لوڈ کریں، اسے لکھیں، دستخط کریں اور اس کی صاف فوٹو کھینچیں۔

یا تو اپنے موبائل نمبر سے سروس آن لائن پورٹل پر رجسٹر کر کے خود درخواست دیں، یا کاغذات لے کر اپنے بلاک آفس کے RTPS کاؤنٹر یا کسی وسودھا کیندر (CSC) پر جائیں۔ یہ سرٹیفکیٹ مفت ہیں؛ کیوسک کے چھوٹے سے مقررہ چارج کے علاوہ کچھ بھی نہ دیں۔
اس نمونے کی طرح محکمہ، سروس اور سرٹیفکیٹ کا لیول چنیں۔
فارم بھریں، ناموں کی ہندی اسپیلنگ اور لسٹ سے چنی گئی ذات کا خاص دھیان رکھیں۔
کاغذات اپ لوڈ کر کے جمع کریں۔ درخواست نمبر لکھ لیں، یہ SMS سے بھی آتا ہے۔
پہلے کرمچاری اور پھر سرکل آفیسر ریکارڈ کی جانچ کرتے ہیں اور سرٹیفکیٹ پر ڈیجیٹل دستخط ہو جاتے ہیں۔
اپنے درخواست نمبر سے پورٹل سے ڈاؤن لوڈ کریں، یا RTPS کاؤنٹر سے لے لیں۔ ڈیجیٹل دستخط کے بعد اس پر کسی مہر یا تصدیق کی ضرورت نہیں۔
اگر رائٹ ٹو پبلک سروس ایکٹ کے تحت مقررہ مدت گزر جائے اور کچھ نہ ہو، تو اسی ایکٹ کے تحت ملنے والی پہلی اپیل اس آفس میں دیں جس کا نام آپ کی رسید پر لکھا ہے۔

schemes.title: Chandigarh Old Age Pension
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Chandigarh Administration
schemes.brief: A monthly pension for Chandigarh residents aged 60 and above whose family income is up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. The UT pays Rs.1,000 a month, and with the central share the pensioner gets Rs.1,200, or Rs.1,500 from age 80. You apply at any Sampark centre, where the operator scans your documents and files the application online. The pension is paid every month into your Aadhaar-seeded bank account. About 18,600 people get it.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,200 a month (Rs.1,500 from age 80), including the central share
eligibility: Age 60 years or above
Total family income not above Rs.1.5 lakh a year
Living in Chandigarh for more than 3 years
Not already getting another pension (the form asks for the amount and source if you do)
documents: Two passport-size photographs, one cross-signed on the form
آدھار کارڈ
Residence proof for the last three years (voter card, ration card, electricity bill, house allotment letter or residence certificate)
Date of birth proof (birth certificate, school leaving certificate, passport, PAN card or senior citizen card)

schemes.title: Krishak Unnati Yojana (Paddy Difference Amount)
schemes.department: Agriculture Development & Farmers Welfare Department, Government of Chhattisgarh, with the Food Department and cooperative societies (paddy procurement)
schemes.brief: Chhattisgarh pays its farmers Rs 3,100 a quintal for paddy. The cooperative society pays the central MSP when you sell, and Krishak Unnati Yojana later pays the gap between MSP and Rs 3,100, on up to 21 quintals an acre, straight into your bank account. You do not fill a separate form for it. You only need to be registered at your cooperative society for paddy sale and sell your paddy there in the procurement season. Farmers who sold paddy earlier and now sow pulses, oilseeds or maize instead also get per-acre help under the same scheme.
schemes.benefit: Gap between MSP and Rs 3,100 a quintal on up to 21 quintals an acre: Rs 731 a quintal (Rs 15,351 an acre) for common paddy in kharif 2025-26
eligibility: A farmer in Chhattisgarh registered for paddy sale at a primary cooperative society (sewa sahkari samiti or LAMPS)
From the 2026-27 season the AgriStack Farmer ID is the registration; the society enters your land, bank and nominee details. The last date given for 2026-27 was 31 October 2026
You must actually sell your paddy at the society's procurement centre in the season (mid-November to January). The limit is 21 quintals an acre, on the area shown in the Digital Crop Survey
Sharecroppers (adhiya, rega), forest rights patta holders, village kotwars and registered institutions can also register; they were exempted from AgriStack in 2025-26
Farmers who sold paddy at MSP the previous year and now grow pulses, oilseeds or maize instead get input help per acre after the crop area is checked
documents: Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked to it
AgriStack Farmer ID (Kisan ID)
B-1 and khasra (P-II) copy of your land, and the Kisan Kitab (Rin Pustika)
Bank passbook of an account in the farmer's own name, linked to Aadhaar
Name and Aadhaar of a nominee
Sharecroppers: the written adhiya or rega agreement with the land owner; forest land: the van adhikar patra
schemes.submitAt: Go to the primary cooperative society (sewa sahkari samiti or LAMPS) where your village sells paddy, before the registration deadline (31 October for the 2026-27 season). Take your Aadhaar card, AgriStack Farmer ID, B-1 and khasra copy, Kisan Kitab and bank passbook. If you do not have a Farmer ID yet, the society operator can make it for you on the spot, or you can make it at a CSC or yourself on cgfr.agristack.gov.in. Farmers who sold at the society last year are already on its list and only need to check that their land and bank details are correct.

demoSteps: Make your AgriStack Farmer ID if you do not have one, at the society, a CSC or on cgfr.agristack.gov.in, using your Aadhaar and land details.
Before 31 October, go to your cooperative society and get your land, bank and nominee details entered for the paddy season.
When procurement opens in mid-November, take a token for your selling day from the society or on the Token Tuhar Hath app.
Bring your paddy to the procurement centre on the token date. It is weighed and bought at MSP, and the MSP amount reaches your bank account within a few days.

After the season, the state pays the Krishak Unnati difference (Rs 3,100 minus MSP, for every quintal you sold) into the same account in one go. The 2025-26 amount was paid in early 2026, before Holi.
If the money does not come, take your sale receipt and passbook to the society manager or the Rural Agriculture Extension Officer (RAEO) and ask them to check your entry.

schemes.title: Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh Ayushman Swasthya Yojana (Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: State Nodal Agency, Directorate of Health Services, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Chhattisgarh, with the National Health Authority
schemes.brief: Chhattisgarh's free hospital treatment scheme for every family with a ration card. It used to be called the Dr. Khubchand Baghel Swasthya Sahayata Yojana and was renamed in 2024. Antyodaya and Priority (BPL) ration card families get cashless treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, and other (APL) ration card families get up to Rs 50,000 a year, at empanelled government and private hospitals. You show the Ayushman card at the hospital. You can make it on the Ayushman portal or app, or free at the hospital's Ayushman desk with your Aadhaar and ration card.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year for BPL families, Rs 50,000 a year for APL families, cashless
eligibility: Families with an Antyodaya or Priority (BPL) ration card from the Chhattisgarh Food Department: up to Rs 5 lakh a year
Families with any other (APL) Chhattisgarh ration card: up to Rs 50,000 a year
Every person aged 70 and above, whatever the income, can also get Rs 5 lakh under the Ayushman Vay Vandana card
Covers about 1,961 treatments, including cancer, heart and kidney care, dialysis, joint replacement, cataract and newborn care
Tests up to 7 days before admission, and check-ups and medicines up to 10 days after discharge, are included
For very costly rare illnesses beyond this cover, BPL families can ask for help of up to Rs 25 lakh under the separate Mukhyamantri Vishesh Swasthya Sahayata Yojana

demoFields.value: فون کے کیمرے سے کھینچی گئی
demoFields.hint: Face straight, good light, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.

demoFields.hint: یہ ممبر راشن کارڈ پر سب سے پہلے لکھے شخص کا کیا لگتا ہے۔

demoFields.label: ضلع اور PIN کوڈ
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so nearby empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose Chhattisgarh and search for your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Next to each member whose e-KYC is pending, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication and take the live photo.
Submit. The state agency checks the request, usually within a day or two, and you get an SMS.
Log in again and download the Ayushman card. If you cannot do it on the phone, the Ayushman desk at any empanelled hospital, a CSC or a choice centre makes it free.
At the hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk with the card, ration card and Aadhaar. Do not pay cash for a treatment covered by the scheme; call 104 if anyone asks for money.
schemes.helpline: 104 (Ayushman Chhattisgarh helpline) / 14555 (Ayushman Bharat national helpline)

schemes.title: چھتیس گڑھ ای-ڈسٹرکٹ — آمدنی، ذات اور رہائش کے سرٹیفکیٹ
schemes.department: چھتیس گڑھ انفوٹیک پروموشن سوسائٹی (CHiPS)، چھتیس گڑھ سرکار
schemes.brief: چھتیس گڑھ ای-ڈسٹرکٹ وہ سرٹیفکیٹ جاری کرتا ہے جو شہری سے بار بار مانگے جاتے ہیں — آمدنی، ذات، ڈومیسائل یا رہائش، پیدائش، موت اور شادی — ساتھ میں ریونیو، سماجی بہبود اور لائسنس کی دوسری سروسز بھی۔ آپ درخواست دیتے ہیں، کاغذات اپ لوڈ کرتے ہیں، فیس ادا کرتے ہیں، ریفرنس نمبر سے فائل کا اسٹیٹس دیکھتے ہیں اور دستخط شدہ سرٹیفکیٹ PDF میں ڈاؤن لوڈ کرتے ہیں۔ شہری لاگ اِن cgedistrict.cgstate.gov.in پر ہے، اور نئی سروسز ریاست کے سیوا سیتو پلیٹ فارم sewasetu.cgstate.gov.in پر منتقل کی جا رہی ہیں۔
schemes.benefit: آمدنی، ذات، ڈومیسائل اور پیدائش، موت، شادی کے رجسٹریشن سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے آن لائن درخواست، اور دستخط شدہ PDF ڈاؤن لوڈ
eligibility: چھتیس گڑھ کے رہائشی، اسی ضلع اور تحصیل میں درخواست دیں جہاں آپ رہتے ہیں
ذات کا سرٹیفکیٹ: آپ کی برادری چھتیس گڑھ کی اپنی نوٹیفائیڈ SC، ST یا OBC لسٹ میں ہونی چاہیے، اور دعوے کی جانچ آپ کے والد کے ریکارڈ سے ہوتی ہے — دوسری ریاست کا سرٹیفکیٹ یہاں نہیں مانا جاتا
ڈومیسائل یا رہائشی سرٹیفکیٹ: خاندان لگاتار چھتیس گڑھ میں رہا ہو، جو عام طور پر زمین کے ریکارڈ، اسکول کے ریکارڈ یا ووٹر لسٹ کے پرانے اندراج سے دکھایا جاتا ہے
آمدنی کا سرٹیفکیٹ: رقم پورے خاندان کی مالی سال کی ہر ذریعے سے آمدنی ہوتی ہے، اور اس پر پٹواری جانچ کر سکتا ہے
پیدائش، موت اور شادی کے سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے متعلقہ شخص یا اس کے قریبی گھر والے درخواست دیتے ہیں
چالو موبائل نمبر، کیونکہ رجسٹریشن اور ہر اسٹیٹس میسج OTP پر چلتا ہے
documents: درخواست دینے والے کا آدھار کارڈ
خاندان کا راشن کارڈ
پتے کا ثبوت — ووٹر ID، بجلی کا بل یا پنچایت/وارڈ کا سرٹیفکیٹ

ڈومیسائل کے لیے زمین کا ریکارڈ (B-1 / کھسرہ-کھتونی) یا پرانا اسکول ٹرانسفر سرٹیفکیٹ
آمدنی کا ثبوت — سیلری سلپ، فارم 16، یا پٹواری یا سرپنچ کا آمدنی کا بیان
سروس کے صفحے پر دیے گئے فارم پر سیلف ڈکلیریشن یا حلف نامہ
حالیہ پاسپورٹ سائز فوٹو، اسکین کی ہوئی

demoFields.hint: سب سے پہلے سروس چنیں۔ ہر سروس کی اپنی کاغذات کی لسٹ اور اپنی فیس ہوتی ہے، جو سروس کے صفحے پر دکھائی جاتی ہے۔

demoFields.hint: آدھار کے مطابق۔ ذات کے سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے آفیسر والد کے ذریعے دعوے کی جانچ کرتا ہے، اس لیے یہ آپ کے اپ لوڈ کیے گئے ریکارڈ سے ملنا چاہیے۔

demoFields.hint: فائل یہاں لکھی تحصیل کے تحصیلدار کے پاس جاتی ہے۔ وہ جگہ لکھیں جہاں آپ اصل میں رہتے ہیں، کسی رشتے دار کا پتہ نہیں۔

demoFields.hint: پورے خاندان کی مالی سال کی ہر ذریعے سے آمدنی۔ پٹواری اس کی جانچ کر سکتا ہے، اور اگر رقم اس کی رپورٹ سے میل نہ کھائے تو درخواست رد ہو جاتی ہے۔

demoFields.hint: لکھیں کہ کس کام کے لیے چاہیے۔ اسکالرشپ، داخلے اور اسکیموں کی درخواستوں میں حال ہی میں بنا سرٹیفکیٹ مانگا جاتا ہے، اس لیے ضرورت کے وقت کے قریب درخواست دیں۔

demoFields.hint: ریفرنس نمبر اور ہر اسٹیٹس اپڈیٹ یہیں آتا ہے۔ سرٹیفکیٹ ڈاؤن لوڈ ہونے تک نمبر چالو رکھیں۔

demoSteps: edistrict.cgstate.gov.in کھولیں، شہری لاگ اِن پر جائیں اور اپنے موبائل نمبر اور OTP سے ایک بار رجسٹر کریں۔
سروس چنیں، اس کی کاغذات کی لسٹ پڑھیں، جہاں دونوں مانگے جائیں وہاں ہندی اور انگریزی میں فارم بھریں، اور اسکین اپ لوڈ کریں۔
اگر سروس کی فیس ہے تو آن لائن ادا کریں، جمع کریں، اور اسکرین پر دکھایا گیا ریفرنس نمبر لکھ لیں۔
فائل پٹواری کے پاس اور پھر تحصیلدار یا متعلقہ آفیسر کے پاس جاتی ہے۔ آمدنی، ذات اور ڈومیسائل سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے موقع پر جانچ عام بات ہے، اس لیے اصل کاغذات گھر پر تیار رکھیں۔
پورٹل پر ریفرنس نمبر سے فائل کا اسٹیٹس دیکھیں۔ اس میں لکھا ہوتا ہے کہ فائل کس آفیسر کے پاس ہے اور کس مرحلے پر ہے۔
منظور شدہ سرٹیفکیٹ اسی لاگ اِن سے PDF میں ڈاؤن لوڈ کر کے پرنٹ کریں۔ اس پر ڈیجیٹل دستخط ہونے کی وجہ سے یہ کسی اور مہر کے بغیر مانا جاتا ہے۔
اگر رد ہو جائے تو وجہ پورٹل پر لکھی ہوتی ہے۔ وہی ایک بات ٹھیک کر کے دوبارہ درخواست دیں، یا ریفرنس نمبر لے کر لوک سیوا کیندر یا کلکٹریٹ جائیں۔
schemes.helpline: پورٹل کا کوئی عوامی ہیلپ لائن نمبر جاری نہیں کیا گیا۔ اپنی تحصیل کے لوک سیوا کیندر یا چوائس سینٹر پر، یا اپنے ضلع کلکٹریٹ کے ای-ڈسٹرکٹ سیل میں پوچھیں۔

schemes.title: مہتاری وندن یوجنا — شادی شدہ عورتوں کے لیے ماہانہ مدد
schemes.department: خواتین اور بچوں کی ترقی کا محکمہ، چھتیس گڑھ سرکار
schemes.brief: مہتاری وندن یوجنا چھتیس گڑھ کی اہل شادی شدہ عورت کو ہر مہینے 1,000 روپے — سال میں 12,000 روپے — سیدھے اس کے اپنے بینک کھاتے میں دیتی ہے۔ شادی شدہ عورتوں کے ساتھ بیوہ، طلاق یافتہ اور شوہر کی چھوڑی ہوئی عورتیں بھی اس میں شامل ہیں۔ نیا رجسٹریشن صرف محکمے کی اعلان کردہ مدت میں کھلتا ہے؛ اس کے بیچ میں بھی پورٹل پر درخواست کا اسٹیٹس دیکھنے، فائدہ پانے والوں کی عارضی اور آخری لسٹ پڑھنے، اعتراض درج کرنے اور ہر قسط پر نظر رکھنے کا کام ہوتا ہے۔
schemes.benefit: ہر مہینے 1,000 روپے، سال میں 12,000 روپے، عورت کے اپنے آدھار سے جڑے کھاتے میں
eligibility: شادی شدہ عورت جو چھتیس گڑھ کی مستقل رہائشی ہو؛ بیوہ، طلاق یافتہ اور شوہر کی چھوڑی ہوئی عورتیں بھی اہل ہیں
جس سال رجسٹریشن کھلے، اس سال کی 1 جنوری کو عمر 21 سال پوری ہو چکی ہو

خاندان میں کوئی انکم ٹیکس دینے والا نہ ہو، اور کوئی ممبر مرکزی یا ریاستی سرکار، کسی بورڈ، کارپوریشن یا سرکاری ادارے میں مستقل یا کنٹریکٹ کی نوکری پر نہ ہو — کلاس IV اور گروپ D کی نوکریاں نہیں گنی جاتیں
خاندان میں کوئی موجودہ یا سابق MP یا MLA، یا کسی بورڈ یا کارپوریشن کا چیئرمین یا وائس چیئرمین نہ ہو
جو عورت پہلے سے سرکاری سوشل پنشن لے رہی ہے، اسے صرف فرق کی رقم ملتی ہے، زیادہ سے زیادہ 1,000 روپے مہینہ تک
عورت کے اپنے نام پر بینک کھاتہ، آدھار سے جڑا اور DBT چالو؛ شوہر کے یا جوائنٹ کھاتے میں پیسہ نہیں آئے گا
documents: عورت اور اس کے شوہر کا آدھار کارڈ

schemes.brief: Senior citizens of Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu get Rs.1,500 a month from age 60 and Rs.2,000 a month from age 70, by direct transfer to the bank. It is for domiciles of the UT with a family income up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. You hand in the form at your Gram Panchayat, District Panchayat or Municipal Council. The application should be decided within 30 days, and the pension arrives by the 5th of every month.

schemes.brief: Delhi joined Ayushman Bharat in April 2025 and adds its own Rs 5 lakh on top of the Centre's Rs 5 lakh, so eligible families get Rs 10 lakh a year of free, cashless hospital treatment. Every Delhi resident aged 70 or above gets the Vay Vandana card with the same Rs 10 lakh cover, whatever the income. Treatment is at empanelled government and private hospitals, and free OPD care is given at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs. You can make the card yourself on the phone.

demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so nearby empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose PMJAY and Delhi and search by ration card or Aadhaar. For a person aged 70 or above, use the 70+ option with just Aadhaar.
Find the member marked eKYC pending and verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication.
Take the live photo, fill the mobile number, relation, district and PIN code, and submit.
Approval usually comes within a day or two by SMS. Log in again and download the card from Download Card.
If it does not work online, take Aadhaar and the ration card to a government dispensary or the Ayushman Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital and get the card made there.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk. Never pay cash for a treatment covered by the scheme.

demoFields.label: خاندان کی سالانہ آمدنی (روپے)
demoFields.hint: پورے گھرانے کی مالی سال کی آمدنی۔ EWS سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے حد 8 لاکھ روپے سالانہ ہے اور رقم کی جانچ ہوتی ہے، اس لیے اندازے سے نہ لکھیں۔

demoFields.label: موبائل نمبر اور ای میل
demoFields.hint: یوزر ID، OTP، درخواست نمبر اور سرٹیفکیٹ تیار ہونے کا میسج سب یہیں آتے ہیں۔

demoSteps: edistrict.delhi.gov.in کھولیں اور اپنے آدھار یا ووٹر ID سے نیو یوزر رجسٹریشن کریں۔ موبائل OTP کی تصدیق کریں اور پورٹل کا دیا ہوا یوزر ID لکھ لیں۔
لاگ اِن کریں، محکمہ اور سروس چنیں، اور کچھ بھی بھرنے سے پہلے اس کی کاغذات کی لسٹ پڑھیں۔
فارم بھریں، اسکین اور دستخط شدہ سیلف ڈکلیریشن اپ لوڈ کریں، اور جمع کریں۔ درخواست نمبر لکھ لیں۔

فائل آپ کے سب ڈویژن کے سب ڈویژنل مجسٹریٹ کے آفس جاتی ہے۔ آمدنی، ذات اور ڈومیسائل سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے پٹواری یا مقامی اتھارٹی کی موقع پر جانچ عام بات ہے۔ شادی کے رجسٹریشن کے لیے اپوائنٹمنٹ کی ایک تاریخ دی جاتی ہے جس دن دونوں فریقوں اور تین گواہوں کو خود حاضر ہونا ہوتا ہے۔
پورٹل پر درخواست نمبر سے اسٹیٹس دیکھیں — یہ صفحہ لاگ اِن کے بغیر کھلتا ہے۔
منظوری کے بعد پرنٹ / ڈاؤن لوڈ سرٹیفکیٹ والے آپشن سے ڈیجیٹل دستخط والی PDF لیں۔ کوئی بھی اسے پورٹل کے تصدیق والے صفحے پر چیک کر سکتا ہے، اس لیے ڈاؤن لوڈ کی ہوئی کاپی ہی کافی ثبوت ہے۔
اگر رد ہو جائے تو وجہ درخواست نمبر کے سامنے دکھتی ہے۔ وہ بات ٹھیک کر کے دوبارہ درخواست دیں، یا پرنٹ آؤٹ لے کر اس پر لکھے SDM آفس جائیں۔
schemes.helpline: پورٹل کی کوئی ایک ہیلپ لائن جاری نہیں کی گئی۔ درخواست نمبر لے کر اپنے سب ڈویژن کے سب ڈویژنل مجسٹریٹ کے آفس، یا NCT دہلی سرکار کے ریونیو محکمے کے ڈسٹرکٹ آفس جائیں۔

schemes.title: Delhi Old Age Pension (Financial Assistance to Senior Citizens)
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Govt of NCT of Delhi
schemes.brief: A monthly pension for poor Delhi residents aged 60 and above: Rs 2,000 a month from 60 to 69 (Rs 2,500 for SC, ST and minority applicants) and Rs 2,500 a month from 70 onwards. It is paid every month into your own Aadhaar-linked bank account. You apply on the e-District portal or at the District Social Welfare Office, and new pensions are given only when your assembly constituency's quota has a free slot. The government has proposed raising both rates by Rs 500; until that is notified, these rates apply.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2,000 a month (age 60-69), Rs 2,500 (70+); Rs 500 extra for SC/ST/minority aged 60-69
eligibility: Aged 60 or above
Lived in Delhi for at least 5 years before applying
Yearly income of you and your spouse together below Rs 1 lakh from all sources, including rent and interest
A single-name (not joint) bank account in Delhi, linked to your Aadhaar
Not getting any other pension or financial help from the Centre, Delhi government, MCD, NDMC or anywhere else
documents: Aadhaar card (the online form does not open without it)
Age proof (any one): birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, voter ID, PAN, passport, ration card or Aadhaar
Proof of 5 years in Delhi: old ration card, voter ID, electricity or water bill, bank passbook or similar
Passbook of your single-name bank account in Delhi
One passport-size photo
Income self-declaration in the format given on the portal
SC/ST: caste certificate; minority: religion declaration verified by a religious institution (only for age 60-69)
Recommendation by an MP, MLA or Gazetted Officer, with attested documents

demoFields.label: Service
demoFields.hint: After logging in, open the Social Welfare department's services and pick the old age pension.

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. The pension goes to the bank account linked with this number.

demoFields.label: Applicant name / Father's or husband's name
demoFields.value: Kamla Devi / Late Shri Har Prasad
demoFields.hint: Write the name as on Aadhaar and the bank passbook.

demoFields.label: تاریخِ پیدائش
demoFields.hint: Must show you are 60 or above. Upload the age proof that has this date.

demoFields.label: زمرہ
demoFields.hint: SC, ST and minority applicants aged 60 to 69 get Rs 500 more; attach the caste certificate or religion declaration.

demoFields.label: Assembly constituency and address
demoFields.value: Seemapuri / House 41, Block D, Dilshad Colony
demoFields.hint: Pensions are given against each constituency's quota, so choose the right one.

demoFields.label: Living in Delhi since
demoFields.hint: You need at least 5 years. Upload one document that proves it.

demoFields.label: Annual income of applicant and spouse
demoFields.hint: Must be below Rs 1 lakh from all sources together.

demoFields.label: بینک اکاؤنٹ نمبر اور IFSC
demoFields.hint: A single-name account in a Delhi branch, seeded with Aadhaar. Joint accounts are not accepted.

demoFields.label: Recommended by
demoFields.hint: An MP, MLA or Gazetted Officer must recommend the form and attest the documents.

demoSteps: Open edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in, register as a new user with Aadhaar and mobile number, and log in.
Choose the Social Welfare service for Old Age Assistance and fill in the form.
Upload age proof, residence proof, bank passbook, photo, income self-declaration and the recommended pages, then submit and note the application number.
The District Social Welfare Office checks the application and may call you with original documents. A decision normally comes within 45 days.
If sanctioned, the pension starts from the month after the month you applied and is credited every month to your Aadhaar-linked account.
Check progress on the Social Welfare website's Online Status of Old Age Pension page. Tell the office within a month if your address or bank changes.
schemes.helpline: 9289550124 (Deputy Director, Financial Assistance Schemes, Social Welfare Dept) / 14567 (Elderline, senior citizens helpline)

schemes.title: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana (Rs 2,500 a Month for Women)
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Govt of NCT of Delhi
schemes.brief: Rs 2,500 a month for women aged 21 to 60 from low-income Delhi families. It was announced as the Mahila Samriddhi Yojana and renamed the Delhi Lakshmi Yojana when it started on 1 August 2026. You choose how the money comes: Rs 1,000 a month into a digital rupee (CBDC) wallet to spend and Rs 1,500 into a locked deposit, or the full Rs 2,500 into the deposit. The deposit stays locked till 31 July 2029, and you apply online on the scheme's own portal.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2,500 a month: Rs 1,000 to spend + Rs 1,500 saved, or all Rs 2,500 saved till July 2029
eligibility: Women aged 21 to 60 on the day you apply, who are registered voters in Delhi
Family income of Rs 2.5 lakh a year or less. Only the eldest eligible woman of the family can apply
You, your husband or one of your parents must have lived in Delhi for at least 10 years
Not for income-tax payers, GST filers, women already getting any government pension, or families where anyone is a government employee (regular or contract) or owns a four-wheeler
Family electricity use of 2,400 units a year or less, not more than three living children, and no criminal record
documents: Aadhaar card, plus the Aadhaar and voter ID numbers of every family member above 18
Delhi voter ID card
Proof of 10 years in Delhi (any one): voter ID, ration card, driving licence, or an electricity or gas bill
Age proof (any one): birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, school leaving certificate, PAN, Aadhaar or voter ID
Your photo and signature
Bank account in your name in a listed bank that offers the CBDC wallet (SBI, PNB, Bank of Baroda, Canara, Union, HDFC, ICICI, Axis and others)
APAAR ID of school children aged 3 to 18 and ABHA health ID of family members (the form asks for them)
The application form printed from the portal, signed and stamped by your area MLA or MP

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on your own Aadhaar card. The OTP goes to the mobile number linked with this Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name as per Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Spell your name exactly as it is printed on Aadhaar, or the check will fail.

demoFields.label: جنس
demoFields.hint: Only women can apply, so Female is already chosen.

demoFields.label: تاریخ پیدائش
demoFields.hint: As written on Aadhaar. You must be between 21 and 60 years old on the day you apply.

demoFields.label: Eligibility questions
demoFields.value: Family income Rs 1,80,000 a year; four-wheeler: No; government job in family: No
demoFields.hint: Answer every question truthfully. A false answer means the money is recovered and legal action is taken.

demoFields.label: Living in Delhi since
demoFields.hint: You, your husband or a parent must have 10 years in Delhi. Keep one old proof, like a voter ID or ration card, ready to upload.

demoFields.label: Family member details
demoFields.hint: Add everyone who shares your kitchen. Give Aadhaar and voter ID of adults and the APAAR ID of children aged 3 to 18.

demoFields.label: بینک اکاؤنٹ نمبر اور IFSC
demoFields.hint: Your own account in one of the listed banks with the CBDC wallet facility. If you have none, the partner bank will open one.

demoFields.label: Payment option
demoFields.value: Option 1: Rs 1,000 to CBDC wallet + Rs 1,500 to RD/FD
demoFields.hint: Option 2 puts the whole Rs 2,500 into the deposit, locked till 31 July 2029.

demoFields.label: MP/MLA endorsement
demoFields.value: Signed form uploaded (MLA of the area)
demoFields.hint: After the preview, download the QR-coded form, get it signed and stamped by your area MLA or MP, and upload it.

demoSteps: Open dly.delhi.gov.in and tap Register. Enter your Aadhaar number, name as on Aadhaar, date of birth and the captcha, and verify with the OTP to create your login.
Log in, answer the eligibility questions, then fill your personal details, every family member, your bank account, and the payment option.
Upload Aadhaar, voter ID, 10-year residence proof, age proof, photo and signature. Preview everything and submit.
Download the QR-coded form, get it signed and stamped by your MLA or MP, upload it, and save the acknowledgement slip.
The district Women and Child Development office checks the papers and the district committee approves. You get SMS updates, and Track Application on the portal shows the status by mobile number.

Payment starts from the month after you apply (apply by 31 July, paid from August). Each month Rs 1,000 reaches the CBDC wallet and Rs 1,500 the deposit, or Rs 2,500 the deposit if you chose option 2.
schemes.helpline: 011-23862652 (Director's office, Women and Child Development Dept, Kashmere Gate) / email wcd@nic.in / complaints on cmjansunwai.delhi.gov.in

schemes.title: Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSSS Pension)
schemes.department: Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa
schemes.brief: Goa's monthly pension for senior citizens, widows, single women, persons with disabilities and people living with HIV/AIDS, from families earning up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. It pays Rs.2,000 to Rs.4,000 a month straight into the bank account, by the 10th of each month. The form is handed in at the Directorate of Social Welfare in Panaji or the District Welfare Office in Margao. An increase of at least Rs.500 a month was proposed in 2026 but had not been notified when this was checked.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,000 a month; Rs.2,500 for widows and single women; up to Rs.4,000
eligibility: Senior citizen aged 60 or above on the day of applying
Widow aged 18 or above (Rs.4,000 if her youngest child is under 21); divorced, deserted or separated woman aged 18 or above; unmarried woman above 50
Person with a disability under the RPwD Act 2016 (Rs.2,500 for a child, Rs.3,500 for 90–100% disability), or a person living with HIV/AIDS
Resident of Goa by birth, or by domicile of 15 years
Annual family income not above Rs.1.5 lakh
A Griha Aadhar holder must sign an undertaking to cancel Griha Aadhar once DSSS is sanctioned
documents: Birth certificate or other age proof notified by the government
15-year residence certificate
Income certificate, or a self-declaration on Rs.50 stamp paper in the set format
Verification certificate
Aadhaar card and bank passbook copy
Disability certificate (persons with disability); spouse's death certificate and marriage certificate (widows)
Self-declaration on Rs.50 stamp paper (unmarried single women); legal guardianship certificate (intellectual disability or autism)
schemes.submitAt: Directorate of Social Welfare, 18th June Road, opposite Salcete Pharmacy, Panaji (North Goa, 0832-2232257), or the District Welfare Office, Mathany Saldanha Administrative Complex, Ground Floor, Block 21, Margao (South Goa, 0832-2794021). Ask for the DSSS form at the counter, attach self-attested copies of the documents, carry the originals for checking, pay the Rs.200 registration fee and keep the receipt.

demoFields.label: زمرہ
demoFields.hint: Senior citizen, single woman, widow, person with disability or HIV/AIDS. Tick only one.

demoFields.label: پورا نام
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar and bank passbook.

demoFields.label: تاریخ پیدائش اور عمر
demoFields.hint: As on your birth certificate or other age proof. Seniors must be 60 on the day of applying.

demoFields.label: Address and constituency
demoFields.hint: Your full address in Goa and your assembly constituency.

demoFields.label: گوا میں رہائش
demoFields.hint: Born in Goa, or living here for at least 15 years, shown by the residence certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual family income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Total family income from all sources. It must not be above Rs.1,50,000.

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: Your own 12-digit Aadhaar; the bank account should be linked to it.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: A savings account in your own name. The pension is paid only here.

demoFields.label: موبائل نمبر
demoFields.hint: So the department can call you about the field check or sanction.

demoSteps: Get the income certificate (or the Rs.50 stamp-paper declaration) and the 15-year residence certificate ready, then collect the DSSS form at the Directorate in Panaji or the District Welfare Office in Margao.
Fill in the form, attach self-attested copies, and get the verification certificate signed.
Submit it with the Rs.200 registration fee and keep the receipt. If the scheme's limit is full, you are put on a waiting list, first come, first served.
The department checks your papers and issues a sanction order with your DSS sanction number.
The pension is credited to your bank account by the 10th of every month.

Every year between 1 April and 30 May, give a life certificate (signed before a Gazetted Officer, MLA, MP, Sarpanch, municipal chairperson or bank manager) and an income certificate, or the pension stops.
schemes.helpline: 8882988000 — Dayanand Social Security Scheme helpline / 0832-2232257 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Panaji / 0832-2794021 — District Welfare Office, Margao

schemes.title: گوا سرکاری بھرتی — CBES آن لائن
schemes.department: گوا اسٹاف سلیکشن کمیشن اور پرسونل محکمہ، گوا سرکار
schemes.brief: گوا کا آن لائن بھرتی سسٹم، جہاں ریاستی سرکاری عہدوں کے اشتہار شائع ہوتے ہیں اور درخواستیں جمع کی جاتی ہیں۔ ایک ہی پروفائل ہر اشتہار کے لیے کام آتی ہے، اور ایڈمٹ کارڈ اور رزلٹ بھی اسی لاگ اِن میں آتے ہیں۔
schemes.benefit: گوا کی ہر سرکاری بھرتی کے اشتہار کے لیے ایک ہی پروفائل
eligibility: ہندوستانی شہری جو اشتہار میں دی گئی عمر کی حد پوری کرتا ہو، عام طور پر 18 سے 45 سال
زیادہ تر ریاستی عہدوں کے لیے گوا میں پندرہ سال کی رہائش ضروری ہے، جو رہائشی سرٹیفکیٹ سے ثابت کی جاتی ہے
بہت سے عہدوں کے لیے کونکنی زبان آنا ضروری ہے، اور اکثر مراٹھی جاننے والے کو ترجیح ملتی ہے
اشتہار میں بتائی گئی تعلیمی قابلیت، جو آخری تاریخ تک پوری ہو چکی ہو
documents: آدھار کارڈ
تاریخ پیدائش کے لیے دسویں کا سرٹیفکیٹ
ڈگری یا ڈپلوما کے سرٹیفکیٹ اور مارک شیٹ
گوا میں پندرہ سال کی رہائش دکھانے والا رہائشی سرٹیفکیٹ
کونکنی زبان جاننے کا سرٹیفکیٹ، جہاں عہدے کے لیے ضروری ہو
ذات یا معذوری کا سرٹیفکیٹ، اگر اس ریزرویشن کا دعویٰ کر رہے ہوں
حالیہ پاسپورٹ سائز فوٹو اور اسکین کیا ہوا دستخط

بھرا ہوا فارم پرنٹ کریں اور بھرتی ختم ہونے تک اسے فیس کی رسید کے ساتھ سنبھال کر رکھیں۔
اسی لاگ اِن سے ایڈمٹ کارڈ ڈاؤن لوڈ کریں اور اسے کسی فوٹو شناختی کارڈ کے ساتھ لے کر جائیں۔

schemes.title: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY Card)
schemes.department: Directorate of Health Services, Government of Goa
schemes.brief: Goa's own health insurance for almost every family that has lived in the state for five years or more. Since July 2026 it pays up to Rs.4 lakh a year for a family of up to three, and Rs.6 lakh for a family of four or more, cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals. You pay only a small registration fee, and the card must be renewed every policy year (1 April to 31 March) on Goa Online.
schemes.benefit: Rs.4 lakh a year (up to 3 members) or Rs.6 lakh (4 or more), cashless
eligibility: Anyone who has lived in Goa for five years or more, together with their family
Family means spouse, unmarried children and dependent parents (or parents-in-law if the eligible person is a woman); one family cannot be split across two cards
There is no income limit
Central and State government employees covered by government medical reimbursement are not eligible
Fee: Rs.200 for 3 or fewer members, Rs.300 for 4 or more; OBC (non-creamy layer), SC, ST and differently abled families pay half
documents: Aadhaar card (or enrolment slip) of every family member above 5 years
Residence proof of the eligible person issued at least 5 years ago in Goa: passport, residence certificate, voter ID, driving licence or Aadhaar, with the issue date visible
Ration card, to show who is in the family
Without a ration card: marriage certificate for the spouse, birth or school leaving certificate for children, and a declaration that the parents are not employed
Birth certificate for a minor who has no Aadhaar
For the fee concession: caste certificate (with income certificate below Rs.6 lakh for OBC) or disability certificate

demoFields.label: تاریخِ پیدائش
demoFields.hint: As on the Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the eligible person's own Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: موبائل نمبر
demoFields.hint: Approval and card messages come here by SMS.

demoFields.label: Residence proof
demoFields.hint: Must have been issued in Goa at least 5 years ago, and the issue date must be visible on the scan.

demoFields.label: Family member 1
demoFields.hint: Name, relation and Aadhaar of each member. Add every member; a family cannot be split.

demoFields.label: Family member 2
demoFields.hint: For a child under 5 without Aadhaar, attach the birth certificate instead.

demoFields.label: Family member 3
demoFields.hint: A woman eligible person can add dependent parents-in-law. Four members means Rs.6 lakh cover and a Rs.300 fee.

demoFields.label: Concession category
demoFields.hint: Choose OBC (non-creamy layer), SC, ST or differently abled only if you upload the certificate; the fee is then halved.

demoFields.label: Office to collect the card
demoFields.hint: Pick the health office nearest your home. Collect the card there within 30 days of approval.

demoSteps: Register on goaonline.gov.in with your mobile OTP and log in. Open Services, All Services, then Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY) - New Enrollment.
Fill in the eligible person's details, add each family member with Aadhaar, and upload the self-attested 5-year residence proof.
Choose a concession category if you have one, pay the fee (Rs.200 for up to 3 members, Rs.300 for 4 or more) and note the acknowledgement number.
If the application is marked for compliance, reply within 30 days, or it is rejected and the fee is forfeited.
When the SMS says it is approved, download the e-card and collect the DDSSY card from the office you chose within 30 days.
Show the card at the DDSSY desk of an empanelled hospital for cashless treatment. Renew it every year before 31 March through DDSSY - Renewal, using the card number and OTP.
schemes.helpline: 8882988000 — Goa Online helpline for DDSSY enrolment and renewal (9:45 am to 5:30 pm) / 0832-2225561 — Directorate of Health Services, Panaji

schemes.title: گوا آن لائن — سرٹیفکیٹ اور سرکاری خدمات
schemes.department: گوا سرکار
schemes.brief: گوا آن لائن ریاست کی سنگل ونڈو ہے۔ رہائشی اور آمدنی کے سرٹیفکیٹ، پیدائش اور موت کے ریکارڈ، اسکیموں کی درخواستیں، لائسنس اور محکموں کی ادائیگیاں سب یہیں جمع ہوتی ہیں، اور یہی خدمات سٹیزن سروس سینٹر کے کاؤنٹر پر بھی ملتی ہیں۔
schemes.benefit: رہائشی، آمدنی اور دوسرے سرٹیفکیٹ اور اسکیموں کی درخواستیں ایک ہی جگہ
eligibility: گوا کا رہائشی، جو اسی تعلقہ میں درخواست دے جہاں وہ رہتا ہے
رہائشی سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے یہ ثبوت چاہیے کہ خاندان مقررہ مدت سے گوا میں رہ رہا ہے
پورٹل کی کچھ اسکیموں کے لیے گوا میں پندرہ سال کی رہائش ضروری ہے؛ ہر اسکیم اپنے فارم پر یہ بتاتی ہے
انکم سرٹیفکیٹ ایک سال کے لیے کارآمد ہوتا ہے
documents: درخواست دینے والے کا آدھار کارڈ
خاندان کا راشن کارڈ
پتے کے لیے بجلی کا بل یا ہاؤس ٹیکس کی رسید
تاریخِ پیدائش کے لیے پیدائش کا سرٹیفکیٹ یا اسکول لیونگ سرٹیفکیٹ
آمدنی کے سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے تنخواہ کا سرٹیفکیٹ یا فارم 16
پاسپورٹ سائز فوٹو اور اسکین کیے ہوئے دستخط

demoFields.hint: تعلقہ کے ریکارڈ میں خاندان کی پہچان کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

demoFields.hint: رہائشی سرٹیفکیٹ کے لیے۔ اسکول کا ریکارڈ، راشن کارڈ یا پرانا بجلی کا بل اس کا ثبوت ہوتے ہیں۔

demoSteps: goaonline.gov.in پر اپنے موبائل سے رجسٹر کریں اور OTP سے تصدیق کریں، یا سٹیزن سروس سینٹر جائیں، جہاں کاؤنٹر پر ہی درخواست جمع ہو جاتی ہے۔
خدمت چنیں اور اپنا آدھار اور راشن کارڈ دیکھ کر فارم بھریں۔

ماملتدار سرٹیفکیٹ پر دستخط کرتا ہے اور یہ اسی لاگ اِن سے ڈاؤن لوڈ ہوتا ہے۔

schemes.title: Griha Aadhar (Homemaker Allowance)
schemes.department: Directorate of Women & Child Development, Government of Goa
schemes.brief: Rs.1,500 every month in the bank account of a Goan homemaker whose family earns up to Rs.3 lakh a year, to help with household costs. It is for married women, widows and divorcees who have lived in Goa for 15 years. Apply on Goa Online; the money arrives by the 10th of each month. The 2026-27 budget announced an increase, but the new amount had not been notified when this was checked.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 a month, credited by the 10th
eligibility: Married woman, widow or divorcee aged 18 or above
Resident of Goa for at least 15 years; if she was born outside Goa, the husband's 15-year residence is checked too
Combined gross income of wife and husband not above Rs.3 lakh a year
Not for women who are, or whose husbands are, regular government or listed public-sector employees
Cannot be drawn together with the Dayanand Social Security pension, except by some widows with young children
documents: Birth certificate of the applicant
Marriage certificate (husband's death certificate for a widow, divorce order for a divorcee)
Residence certificate showing 15 years in Goa (husband's birth and residence certificates if you were born outside Goa)
Voter ID or Aadhaar card
Income proof, with the self-declaration of occupation and income
Savings bank account details, with the account linked to Aadhaar
Photo and signature of the applicant
Verification report signed by a Gazetted Officer, MLA or MP (format on the Goa Online page)

demoSteps: Register on goaonline.gov.in with your mobile OTP and log in.
Open Services, All Services, Directorate of Women & Child Development, Griha Aadhar Scheme, and answer the eligibility questions.
Fill in the form and upload the documents, including the verification report signed by a Gazetted Officer, MLA or MP.
Save, pay the fee shown, and note the acknowledgement number sent by SMS and email.
The Directorate checks the application and may verify it at your home; you then get a sanction order.

schemes.title: Namo Saraswati Vigyan Sadhana Yojana (Class 11-12 Science)
schemes.department: محکمہ تعلیم، گجرات
schemes.brief: Rs.25,000 over two years for a student who takes the science stream in classes 11 and 12 in Gujarat - Rs.1,000 a month for 10 months in each year, and Rs.5,000 after passing the Class 12 science board exam. It is for students who scored at least 50% in the Class 10 board and study in a government, grant-in-aid or self-financed school. Parents do not apply anywhere: the school enrols the student, so the documents go to the school. The money is paid straight into the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Rs.25,000 in all: Rs.10,000 in each of classes 11 and 12, plus Rs.5,000 on passing Class 12
eligibility: Studying class 11 or 12 in the science stream at a government, grant-in-aid or self-financed school in Gujarat
Scored at least 50% in the Class 10 board exam
خاندان کی آمدنی سال میں 6 لاکھ روپے تک
The monthly money depends on the student staying in school; a student who leaves stops getting it
The Rs.5,000 is paid only after passing the Class 12 science board exam
documents: Student's Aadhaar card
Class 10 board marksheet
Bank account in the student's name, or joint with the mother, linked with Aadhaar
Income certificate, or the declaration form the school gives
ماں یا باپ کا آدھار کارڈ
School admission (GR) number or leaving certificate
والدین کا موبائل نمبر
schemes.submitAt: At the school where the student is in Class 11 science. Give copies to the class teacher or to the teacher or clerk the school has made in charge of Namo Saraswati - the school enters the student on the state's Namo payment portal from its own login. Take the student's Aadhaar, Class 10 marksheet, bank passbook and income proof.

demoSteps: Open a bank account in the student's name (or joint with the mother) and get Aadhaar linked to it.
Soon after admission to Class 11 science, give the school copies of the Aadhaar, Class 10 marksheet, passbook and income proof.

schemes.title: گجرات راشن کارڈ - نیا کارڈ یا ممبر کا نام جوڑنا
schemes.department: فوڈ، سول سپلائیز اور کنزیومر افیئرز محکمہ، گجرات
schemes.brief: نئے خاندان کے لیے بارکوڈ والا راشن کارڈ، یا کسی ممبر کا نام جوڑنا - نیا پیدا ہوا بچہ، یا خاندان میں آئی دلہن۔ چھپے ہوئے فارم محکمے کی سائٹ پر گجراتی میں ہیں: نئے کارڈ کے لیے فارم 1 اور 2، ممبر جوڑنے کے لیے فارم 3۔ زیادہ تر لوگ یہ فارم جن سیوا کیندر پر یا e-Gram سینٹر پر VCE کے ذریعے بھرتے ہیں اور تعلقہ کے ماملتدار دفتر میں جمع کرتے ہیں۔ نام جڑ جانے کے بعد اس ممبر کا آدھار e-KYC اپنی راشن کی دکان (فیئر پرائس شاپ) پر کروائیں، ورنہ اضافی اناج شروع نہیں ہوگا۔
