demoSteps: Get the 90-day work certificate in the board's format (the KSK portal has the template), signed by your employer or contractor, a registered construction workers' union, or the labour inspector.

Open kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in, choose Apply for Registration, select 'Register as a New Construction Worker' and verify your Aadhaar-linked mobile with the OTP. Without a smartphone, go to the Karmika Seva Kendra or labour inspector's office in your taluk.
Fill in your personal, family, nominee, bank and work details as in this sample, and upload the documents (JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 2 MB each).
Submit and note the acknowledgement number. The labour inspector checks your documents and may visit the work site.
Once approved, download your e-card (digital labour ID) from your KSK dashboard.
Apply for help (delivery, marriage, medical, pension) from the same dashboard. For your children's education help, apply on the State Scholarship Portal, ssp.karnataka.gov.in.
Renew before the e-card expires: log in, and enter your current employer, work site and a new work certificate. The portal reminds you 15 days before expiry.

schemes.title: Yuva Nidhi (Unemployment Allowance for Graduates and Diploma Holders)
schemes.department: Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Department (Department of Employment and Training), Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka pays a monthly allowance to young people who finished a degree or diploma and still have no job six months after the result: Rs.3,000 a month for graduates and postgraduates, Rs.1,500 for diploma holders. It is paid for up to two years, or until you get a job or start further studies, whichever comes first. You apply on Seva Sindhu (now Seva One), and you must confirm on the portal every three months that you are still unemployed, or the payment stops.
schemes.benefit: Rs.3,000 a month for graduates, Rs.1,500 a month for diploma holders, for up to 2 years
eligibility: Passed a degree, postgraduate degree or diploma from the 2022-23 academic year onward
No job (government or private) and not self-employed for 180 days after the result
Karnataka domicile: studied in Karnataka for at least 6 years, counting SSLC, PUC and the degree or diploma
Not studying further, not drawing an apprenticeship stipend, and not getting any other unemployment allowance
A bank account in your own name, seeded with Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked to it for the OTP
Degree, postgraduate or diploma marks cards and the provisional or final certificate
SSLC and PUC marks cards, as proof of study in Karnataka
Bank passbook of an account in your own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Mobile number and email ID
Self-declaration that you are not employed or studying (made on the portal)

demoSteps: Wait until 180 days have passed since your result date, with no job and no further studies.

Open the Yuva Nidhi service on Seva One (sevaone.karnataka.gov.in), log in or register with your mobile number and OTP, and complete the Aadhaar e-KYC. A Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre can do this for you.
Fill in your qualification, register number, year of passing and SSLC and PUC details, upload the marks cards, and give your Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Submit and note the application number. The district employment officer checks your certificates; follow it with 'Yuvanidhi Application Status Check' on the portal.
Once approved, the allowance is paid into your account every month by DBT. The department may also ask you to register on the Kaushalkar skills portal for training.
Every three months, submit the 'Unemployment Self Declaration' on the portal. If you miss it, the payment stops until you submit it.
When you get a job or join a course, stop declaring. The allowance ends after two years in any case.

schemes.title: Gruha Jyothi (Free Electricity up to 200 Units)
schemes.department: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka, through the electricity supply companies (BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM)
schemes.brief: Karnataka gives every household free electricity up to its usual monthly use, as long as that stays within 200 units. Your free limit is your average monthly use in 2022-23 plus 10 units. Use within that limit and the bill is zero; use more and you pay only for the extra units; cross 200 units in a month and you pay the full bill for that month. You register once, free, by linking the house's electricity account to your Aadhaar. Owners and tenants can both apply.
schemes.benefit: Zero bill up to your free limit (average 2022-23 use + 10 units), up to 200 units a month
eligibility: A domestic (house) electricity connection in Karnataka. Shops and other commercial use are not covered
Owner, tenant or family member living in the house. One connection per Aadhaar, and one connection per house
Monthly use must stay at or below 200 units. Above 200, the full bill is charged for that month
Free limit = average monthly use in 2022-23 plus 10 units. A new house or new connection with no 2022-23 record gets a fixed limit based on the state average of 53 units
Old unpaid electricity dues must be cleared. Homes on Bhagya Jyothi, Kutira Jyothi and Amrut Jyothi are included in Gruha Jyothi
documents: Aadhaar card of the person applying
Latest electricity bill, for the ESCOM name and the Account ID (connection ID)
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
The bill need not be in your name: tenants and family members choose their type in the form
Tenants: a rent agreement or other proof of living at that address, if the office asks for it

demoFields.hint: English or Kannada. The labels of the form change to the language you pick.

demoFields.hint: The company named at the top of your bill: BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM or Hukkeri Society.

demoFields.hint: The account or connection ID printed on your bill, not the meter number. The name and address then fill in from the ESCOM's records.

demoFields.hint: Comes from the ESCOM record. It may be the landlord's name or a late parent's name; that is fine.

demoFields.hint: Filled in automatically. Check that it is the house you actually live in.

demoFields.label: User type
demoFields.hint: Owner, Tenant, or Family member (for example, when the bill is in your father's name).

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. One Aadhaar can be linked to only one connection in the whole state.

demoFields.label: درخواست دینے والے کا نام
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on your Aadhaar. The OTP check matches it.

demoFields.label: Phone number for communication
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement and later messages about the scheme come here.

demoFields.label: اقرار نامہ
demoFields.hint: You confirm the connection is used only for the house. Commercial use cancels the benefit, and the free amount is recovered with interest.

demoSteps: Keep your latest electricity bill ready and find the ESCOM name and the Account ID on it.

Open sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in, choose Gruha Jyothi and click to register. The form opens without any login. A Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre, or your ESCOM office, will also register you free.
Select your ESCOM, type the Account ID and check the name and address that appear. Choose Owner, Tenant or Family member, then enter your Aadhaar and verify it with the OTP.
Tick the declaration, submit, and note the acknowledgement number. You can check the status later on the Seva Sindhu 'Track Status' page.
From the next bill, your bill shows your free limit (eligible units). Within it the bill is zero; above it you pay only for the extra units; above 200 units you pay the whole bill.
Tenants moving house: use the Gruha Jyothi De-link option on the same portal to free your Aadhaar from the old connection, then register again at the new house.
If the bill is not zero, first check the eligible-units line on it, then call 1912 or visit the ESCOM sub-division office with your acknowledgement number.

سیوا سندھو سروسز پورٹل کھولیں، گرہ لکشمی چنیں، اور اپنا راشن کارڈ نمبر ڈالیں۔ پورٹل خاندان کی تفصیل خود بھر دیتا ہے۔
OTP سے اپنے آدھار کی تصدیق کریں، شادی شدہ ہوں تو شوہر کا آدھار جوڑیں، اور اپنے نام کا بینک اکاؤنٹ دیں۔

منظوری کے بعد ہر مہینے 2,000 روپے آتے ہیں۔ اپنے درخواست نمبر سے پورٹل پر منظوری اور ہر ادائیگی کا حال دیکھیں۔

schemes.title: Kerala Construction Workers Welfare Board Membership (Nirmana Thozhilali Kshemanidhi)
schemes.department: Kerala Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour and Skills Department, Government of Kerala
schemes.brief: Membership for masons, carpenters, helpers, painters, electricians, plumbers and other building workers aged 18 to 59. Members pay Rs.50 a month and get a pension after 60, and help at childbirth and marriage, for children's education, medical treatment, disability and death. You join at the Board's district office with proof of age and of 90 days' construction work. The Board has about 20 lakh members but is short of money: in June 2026 the Labour Minister told the Assembly that pensions have been pending since June 2025.
schemes.benefit: Pension Rs.1,600 a month after 60, plus maternity, marriage, education, treatment and death aid
eligibility: Aged 18 to 59 and working in building or other construction work in Kerala
Worked at least 90 days in construction work in the last 12 months
Pay the Rs.50 monthly subscription to keep the membership active; a break can stop your benefits
Pension: 60 or older with at least 5 years of active membership
Maternity aid: women members with at least 1 year of membership, for up to two deliveries
After a member's or pensioner's death, the nominee or spouse can claim the death benefit or family pension
documents: Membership application form from the Board's district office
Age proof: birth certificate, school certificate or Aadhaar
Certificate of at least 90 days' construction work in the last 12 months, from your employer or contractor
Aadhaar card copy
Copy of a bank passbook in the worker's own name
Passport-size photos and your nominee's details
For each benefit later: the Board's claim form for it (Form 34 for pension, Form 38 for disability pension, Form 36 for death benefit) with the Welfare Fund ID card and passbook
schemes.submitAt: The district office of the Kerala Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (District Executive Officer) in your district. Collect the membership form there, attach the copies, pay the first subscription and take a receipt. Head office: Nirman Bhavan, Mettukada, Thycaud, Thiruvananthapuram.

demoSteps: Collect the membership form at the Board's district office in your district.
Fill it and attach the age proof, the 90-day work certificate, Aadhaar, bank passbook copy and photos.
Submit it at the district office with the first subscription and keep the receipt. If the District Executive Officer rejects it, you can appeal to the Board Secretary within 30 days.
You get a Welfare Fund ID card and passbook. Pay Rs.50 every month so the membership stays active.

For a benefit such as maternity, marriage or treatment aid, apply at the same office on the Board's form for it, with the ID card and passbook, soon after the event; after 90 days you must explain the delay.

At 60, with 5 years of active membership, apply for the pension on Form 34 with the ID card, passbook, bank passbook copy and Aadhaar. It is paid into your bank, but payments are running many months late now.

schemes.title: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP Card)
schemes.department: State Health Agency Kerala, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Kerala
schemes.brief: Kerala's free health cover, run together with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. About 42 lakh poorer families get treatment worth up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at about 180 government and 365 private empanelled hospitals. The KASP card is made at the KASP help desk of an empanelled hospital or at an Akshaya centre after an Aadhaar check. The new government plans to merge KASP into a bigger Oommen Chandy Health Insurance Scheme, but until that is notified KASP cards keep working as before.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Families that had an RSBY or CHIS health card in 2018-19, and families on the PM-JAY list (SECC 2011), including those who got the letter from the Prime Minister
About 42 lakh families, the poorest 40% of Kerala. Every member is covered, whatever the age or the size of the family
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one. Costs for 3 days before admission and 15 days after discharge are included
Other families cannot join now. New names are added only when the government announces it

A seriously ill patient from a poor family that is not in KASP can ask the same hospital desk about the Karunya Benevolent Fund: Rs.2 lakh for illnesses such as cancer and heart disease, Rs.3 lakh for kidney disease
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member who needs a card
راشن کارڈ
OTP کے لیے موبائل نمبر
Old RSBY or CHIS card, or the letter from the Prime Minister, if you have one
At admission: the KASP card (or its number) and the patient's Aadhaar
schemes.submitAt: The KASP (PM-JAY) help desk at any empanelled government or private hospital, such as a medical college, district or taluk hospital, or any Akshaya e-Kendra. Take the Aadhaar card of every member who needs a card, the ration card and a mobile phone. There is no paper form: the staff search your family on the computer and check each member's Aadhaar.

demoFields.hint: Fingerprint on the machine. If it fails, an OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile or a face scan is used.

demoFields.hint: A number you keep with you. Messages about the card and hospital approvals come here.

demoFields.hint: Where you live now.

demoFields.hint: Keep the card or a photo of it on your phone. It is valid at every empanelled hospital in the country.

demoSteps: Check if your family is covered: ask at an Akshaya centre or a hospital KASP desk, or call DISHA on 1056.
Go to the KASP desk of an empanelled hospital or an Akshaya centre with each member's Aadhaar, the ration card and your phone.
The staff find your family, check each member's Aadhaar by fingerprint or OTP, take a photo and print the KASP card.
When treatment is needed, go to an empanelled hospital and show the KASP card and Aadhaar at the KASP counter before admission.
The hospital takes approval from the State Health Agency. Medicines, tests, surgery, ICU, room and food in the package are free; do not pay cash for a covered treatment.
If the hospital refuses or asks you to pay, call DISHA 1056 or the State Health Agency before paying.
Not on the list but seriously ill and poor? Ask the same desk how to apply to the Karunya Benevolent Fund.

schemes.title: Social Security Pension (Kshema Pension / Sevana Pension)
schemes.department: Local Self Government Department and Finance Department, Government of Kerala, through grama panchayats, municipalities and corporations
schemes.brief: Kerala's monthly welfare pension, Rs.2,000 since November 2025, for poor elderly people, widows, persons with disabilities, unmarried women over 50 and old agricultural labourers. About 52 lakh people get it. Your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation takes the paper form, checks your case and must decide within 45 days. The money comes every month to your bank account, or a co-operative bank agent hands it over at your home. The new government has promised to raise it to Rs.3,000, but no date has been fixed yet.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,000 a month
eligibility: Family income not above Rs.1 lakh a year, and not an income tax payer
Old age pension: 60 or above. Agricultural labourer pension: 60 or above, at least 10 years as a farm labourer and a member of the Agricultural Workers' Welfare Fund
Widow pension: widows who have not remarried, and women of 50 or more whose husband has been missing or has left them for over 7 years. Unmarried women's pension: unmarried women aged 50 or more
Disability pension: persons with 40% or more disability certified by a medical board

Not eligible: land over 2 acres (except ST families), a car over 1000 cc that is not a taxi, a concrete house over 2,000 sq ft with modern flooring, or a government or PSU service or family pension (ex-gratia or NPS pension up to Rs.4,000 is allowed)
Only one social security pension per person (except persons with disability), applied for in the local body where you live permanently
documents: Age proof: school certificate, birth certificate, church or mosque record, voter ID or Aadhaar
Income certificate from the Village Office
Certificate of permanent residence
Aadhaar card and voter ID card (copy of both sides)
Ration card (copy of the first page and the page with your name)
Bank passbook copy, if you want the pension in a bank
Widows: husband's death certificate. Disability pension: medical board disability certificate
EPF passbook, only if you get an EPF pension below Rs.4,000
schemes.submitAt: The front office of your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation, addressed to the Secretary. The linked form is for the old age pension; the forms for widow, disability, unmarried women and agricultural labourer pensions are on welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in under Application Forms. Fill the form, paste a passport photo taken within the last 6 months, sign it, attach self-attested copies of the documents and take a receipt.

demoFields.label: Gender and category
demoFields.hint: Tick woman, man or transgender, and General, SC or ST.

demoFields.label: Name (in English and in Malayalam)
demoFields.hint: Write the name exactly as on Aadhaar, once in English and once in Malayalam.

demoFields.label: Ward number, ward name and house number
demoFields.hint: From your house tax receipt. The ward member of this ward is asked to confirm your details.

demoFields.label: Address, PIN code and post office
demoFields.hint: The home where you live permanently.

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. Pension is paid only to an Aadhaar-verified person.

demoFields.label: راشن کارڈ نمبر
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy of the first page and the page with your name.

demoFields.label: Annual income
demoFields.hint: The family income shown on your Village Office income certificate. Also write its number and date at the end of the form.

demoFields.label: How you want the pension
demoFields.hint: Choose bank account, money order (EMO) or direct to home, where a co-operative bank agent brings the cash.

demoFields.label: Service pension, income tax, EPF pension?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. A wrong answer later means the pension is stopped and the money recovered.

demoFields.hint: All land in your or your family's name. More than 2 acres makes you ineligible, except for ST families.

demoSteps: Get an income certificate from the Village Office, online on e-District or through an Akshaya centre.
Download and fill the form for your pension type, paste a recent passport photo, sign it and attach the copies.
Hand it in at the front office of your panchayat, municipality or corporation and keep the receipt.
Local body staff check the details and may visit your house. The Secretary must decide within 45 days; if it is refused, you can appeal to the District Collector within 30 days.
Once approved and digitally signed, the pension is due from that month and is paid by DBT to your bank or at your home.
Every year, do the mustering (life check) by fingerprint at an Akshaya centre. Widows and unmarried women under 60 must also give a certificate that they have not married or remarried.
Check your status and payments on welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in under Quick Search or Pension Search.
schemes.helpline: 0471-2327526 — DBT cell for social security pensions; for applications, your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation office

schemes.title: Priyadarshini Scheme (Free KSRTC Bus Travel for Women)
schemes.department: Transport Department, Government of Kerala — Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC)
schemes.brief: Since 15 June 2026, women and transgender persons travel free on KSRTC ordinary buses in Kerala, with no limit on distance. There is no form, card or registration, and no ID is needed: tell the conductor where you are going and take the zero-fare Priyadarshini ticket. Fast Passenger, City Fast and higher-class buses, festival and weekend specials and chartered trips are not free.
schemes.benefit: Free travel on KSRTC ordinary buses, any distance
eligibility: All women and girls, of any age, and transgender persons
No income, residence or caste condition, and nothing to apply for
Covers KSRTC ordinary services; these buses carry 'Priyadarshini Scheme' on both sides and on the front
Not covered: Fast Passenger, City Fast and other higher-class services, BTC services, festival specials, weekend extra services and chartered trips
Private buses are not part of the scheme
documents: Nothing to show: no ID, card or registration is needed
Ask for the zero-fare (Priyadarshini) ticket and keep it until you get down
Normal fare for any men travelling with you
Luggage charge if you carry more than the free limit
schemes.submitAt: There is no form and nowhere to apply. Board a KSRTC ordinary bus marked 'Priyadarshini Scheme', tell the conductor your destination and ask for the zero-fare ticket.

demoFields.label: Board on the bus
demoFields.hint: Written on both sides and the front of every bus in the scheme.

demoFields.label: Boarding point

demoFields.label: Destination
demoFields.hint: Any distance on the bus's route.

demoFields.hint: Each woman and girl gets her own zero-fare ticket. Men get separate paid tickets.

demoSteps: Look for a KSRTC ordinary bus with 'Priyadarshini Scheme' written on the front and sides.
Board the bus, tell the conductor where you are going and ask for the Priyadarshini (zero-fare) ticket. No ID is needed.
Keep the ticket until you get down. Inspection squads check tickets, and travelling without one is not allowed even when it is free.
Men travelling with you get separate paid tickets, and extra luggage needs a luggage ticket.
On Fast Passenger, City Fast, higher-class, special or chartered buses, pay the normal fare.
If a conductor refuses the free ticket on an ordinary bus, note the bus number, route and time and call the KSRTC control room on 149.

schemes.title: State Crop Insurance Scheme and Crop-Loss Relief (AIMS)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture Development and Farmers' Welfare, Government of Kerala, through Krishi Bhavans
schemes.brief: Kerala's own crop insurance. For a small premium, such as Rs.2 a year for a yielding coconut tree or Re.1 a cent for paddy, you get fixed compensation if the crop is fully destroyed by flood, drought, landslide, storm, lightning, sea erosion, wildfire or wild animals; paddy is also covered against pests and disease. You apply and pay on the AIMS portal or app, and the Krishi Bhavan checks the field. Farmers without insurance can still claim the smaller natural-calamity relief on AIMS, for example Rs.700 for a yielding coconut tree. In March 2026 papaya, rambutan and other fruits, flowers and bee boxes were added.
schemes.benefit: For total loss: Rs.2,000 per yielding coconut tree, Rs.35,000 per hectare of paddy, Rs.300 per bunched Nendran banana
eligibility: Any farmer in Kerala who cultivates own or leased land. Paddy farmers can also join as a padasekharam group
Minimum to insure: 10 coconut or arecanut trees, 10 banana plants, 25 rubber trees, or 0.1 hectare (about 25 cents) of paddy
Insure within the crop's window: paddy 15 to 45 days after sowing or transplanting, banana 1 to 5 months after planting; yielding tree crops at any time
Insure the whole crop in that plot, not part of it. Old or low-yielding trees are not accepted

Cover starts 7 days after the premium is paid. Only total loss is paid: paddy loss above 50% counts as total, and for vegetables, ginger, tapioca and similar crops at least 10% of the insured area must be lost
documents: Aadhaar card and the mobile number linked to it, for the OTP
Land tax receipt or other land record; a lease agreement if the land is leased
Passbook of a bank account in the farmer's own name
Crop details: number of trees or plants, or the area, and the planting date
UPI, debit card or net banking to pay the premium online
For a claim: photos of the damaged crop

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number (farmer registration)
demoFields.hint: Registration starts with your Aadhaar and an OTP. You register only once; the same login is used for every AIMS service.

demoFields.hint: Copy these from your land tax receipt. Add the land and the crops on it before applying for insurance.

demoFields.hint: If you farm leased land, choose leased and upload the lease agreement.

demoFields.label: Crop to insure
demoFields.hint: Under Services, open the State Crop Insurance link and press Apply next to the crop.

demoFields.label: Number of trees
demoFields.hint: Insure all the coconut trees in that plot; at least 10 are needed.

demoFields.label: Insurance period
demoFields.hint: For yielding coconut it is Rs.2 per tree for one year, or Rs.5 per tree for three years paid together.

demoFields.label: Premium shown
demoFields.hint: Worked out automatically from the number of trees and the period.

demoFields.label: اقرار نامہ
demoFields.hint: Tick the box above Submit Application, or the application will not go.

demoFields.label: Premium payment (e-Treasury)
demoFields.hint: Pay only after the Krishi Bhavan approves and you get the SMS. Note the GRN number shown after payment.

demoSteps: Register once on AIMS with your Aadhaar and OTP, then add your land and crop details.

Open Services, then State Crop Insurance, press Apply next to the crop, enter the number of trees or the area and the period, tick the declaration and submit. The application goes to your Krishi Bhavan.
Krishi Bhavan staff inspect the field within 10 days. When the premium is approved you get an SMS.
Pay the premium on AIMS within 10 days through e-Treasury (UPI, card or net banking). The policy appears under Policy Issued; download it and the receipt.

If the crop is destroyed, tell the Krishi Bhavan at once or use Report Calamity in AIMS, so the loss is entered. Then apply for the claim on AIMS within 15 days with photos, and leave the damaged crop as it is until the officer inspects it.
The compensation is paid straight into your bank account when funds are released.
If the crop was not insured, apply on AIMS in the same way for natural-calamity relief at the government's lower rates.

schemes.title: Ladakh Universal Health Care Scheme (Golden Card)
schemes.department: Health & Medical Education Department, UT Ladakh
schemes.brief: Ladakh's own free health insurance, started in December 2020 alongside Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY so that families left out of the PM-JAY list are covered too. Every ration card household gets a Golden Card worth Rs.5 lakh a year for hospital treatment, tests and medicines, cashless at empanelled hospitals. The card is made at the Ayushman desk of a government hospital, at an enrolment camp or at a CSC, using the ration card and Aadhaar.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per household, cashless and free
eligibility: Every family in UT Ladakh that holds a ration card
Families already in the PM-JAY list get the PM-JAY card; all others are covered by the UT's own scheme
No income limit and no premium
Newborn babies can be given a Golden Card at birth in the hospital
If your family is missing from the list or a name is wrong, apply first at the Tehsildar's office
documents: Ladakh ration card
Aadhaar card of each family member
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
Birth certificate for a newborn or a child without Aadhaar
For inclusion or name correction: a written application at the Tehsildar's office with copies of the ration card and Aadhaar
schemes.submitAt: The Ayushman (PM-JAY) desk at SNM Hospital Leh, District Hospital Kargil or your nearest Community Health Centre, or a Common Service Centre or Golden Card camp in your block. Take the ration card, every member's Aadhaar card and the mobile phone linked to Aadhaar; each member to be enrolled should come along for the fingerprint, OTP or photo. If your family is not found or a name is wrong, first give an application with the same documents at your Tehsildar's office.

demoSteps: Take the ration card, every member's Aadhaar and the Aadhaar-linked mobile to the Ayushman desk at SNM Hospital Leh, DH Kargil, a CHC, a CSC or a Golden Card camp.
The operator searches your family by ration card or Aadhaar and verifies each member by Aadhaar OTP, fingerprint or face.
A photo is taken and the card request is sent for approval.
Once approved, the Golden Card is printed or given to you to download; you can also keep it on the Ayushman app.
If your family was not found, apply at the Tehsildar's office for inclusion, then go back to the desk to enrol.
At an empanelled hospital, show the card at the Ayushman desk and pay nothing for a covered treatment.

schemes.title: UT of Lakshadweep State Pension Scheme (Old Age Pension)
schemes.department: Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Lakshadweep (through the District Panchayat and Village (Dweep) Panchayats)
schemes.brief: Lakshadweep pays Rs.1,500 a month to permanent residents above 60 who have no income of their own. The same state pension also covers widows, abandoned people and persons with disabilities. You apply at your island's Village (Dweep) Panchayat office. The application is checked there and again at the District Panchayat, Kavaratti, and the money is paid every month into your Aadhaar-linked bank account. About 3,500 islanders get it.

eligibility: Permanent resident of the Union territory of Lakshadweep
Above 60 years of age (the same scheme also covers widows, abandoned persons and persons with disabilities)
No source of income; monthly income not above Rs.1,500
Not getting any other similar government pension
People with no financial support from their family are given priority

demoSteps: Collect the pension form from the Executive Officer at your Village (Dweep) Panchayat office.
Fill it in, attach your documents and hand it back at the VDP office.
The VDP Evaluation Committee checks your application and forwards it to the CEO, District Panchayat, Kavaratti.
District Panchayat officials check it again and add your name to the pensioners' list sent to the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department.
Rs.1,500 is paid every month into your Aadhaar-linked bank account.
If nothing comes, ask the VDP Executive Officer or call the department at Kavaratti.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah / Nikah Yojana (Samuhik Vivah)
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: The state gives Rs 55,000 for each bride who marries at a mass wedding held by a Janpad Panchayat or urban body on a date the district fixes. The bride gets Rs 49,000 by an account payee cheque in her name, and Rs 6,000 goes to the body that holds the event. The Nikah scheme gives the same help at mass nikah events. There is no income limit, but a wedding held on its own does not qualify.
schemes.benefit: Rs 55,000 per bride: Rs 49,000 cheque to the bride + Rs 6,000 to the organiser
eligibility: The bride or her parents are original residents of Madhya Pradesh (the groom may be from another state)
The bride has completed 18 years and the groom 21 years
The bride is unmarried, a widow (Kalyani) or a legally divorced woman, and has not already married in another ceremony
No income limit, but the marriage must take place at a mass wedding or nikah held by a Janpad Panchayat or municipal body on a notified date
Registered construction workers also get this help through the same mass weddings; there is no separate grant for a wedding held on its own
documents: Domicile (original resident) certificate of the bride or her parents
9-digit Samagra member ID of the bride and the groom (not needed for a groom from outside MP)
Aadhaar card copies of the bride and the groom
Age proof for both: school TC, marksheet with date of birth, birth certificate, voter ID, MGNREGA job card or a government doctor's age certificate
Two passport-size photos each of the bride and the groom
Mobile numbers of the bride, the groom and the guardian, if any
For a widow, the former husband's death certificate; for a divorced woman, the court's divorce order
Copy of the construction worker (BOCW) card, if the family is registered
schemes.submitAt: In a village: the Janpad Panchayat office that is holding the mass wedding (forms are free there, and the gram panchayat can help). In a town: the Nagar Nigam, Nagar Palika or Nagar Parishad office. The bride and groom apply together at least 15 days before the wedding date, with copies of all documents and photos. Take the receipt (pavti) the same day.

demoFields.hint: Her own 9-digit number. If she has none, the panchayat or municipal office will make one.

demoFields.hint: Attach a photocopy of her Aadhaar card.

demoFields.hint: Choose widow or divorced if that applies, and attach the death certificate or the court order.

demoFields.value: Rahul Jatav, son of Ramesh Jatav
demoFields.hint: As on the groom's Aadhaar card.

demoFields.hint: He must have completed 21 years. Attach one age proof.

demoFields.hint: A groom from outside Madhya Pradesh writes only his full address; Samagra is not needed.

demoSteps: Find out the mass wedding dates fixed for your area at the Janpad Panchayat or municipal office. Upcoming events are also listed on vivahportal.mp.gov.in.
Collect the free form there or download it. The bride and groom fill it in together and sign their declarations.
Hand it in at least 15 days before the date, with the documents and photos, and keep the receipt (pavti).
A committee checks the papers and enters the result on the Vivah Portal at least 7 days before the wedding. Eligible couples get an approval order and an invitation letter.
Attend the mass wedding on the fixed date. The marriage certificate is issued online through the portal.
The bride receives the Rs 49,000 account payee cheque in her name; deposit it in her own bank account. Track the application on vivahportal.mp.gov.in under Track Application.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (CM Kisan Kalyan)
schemes.department: Department of Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development, with the Revenue Department, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: Madhya Pradesh adds Rs 6,000 a year to the Rs 6,000 farmers get from PM-Kisan, so a farmer family gets Rs 12,000 a year in all. The state pays it in three instalments of Rs 2,000 straight into the bank account. There is no separate form. Every MP farmer approved under PM-Kisan is added automatically once the Patwari has verified the land. This SAARA page shows whether you are active and when each instalment was paid.
schemes.benefit: Rs 6,000 a year (3 instalments of Rs 2,000) on top of PM-Kisan
eligibility: Farmer families in Madhya Pradesh who are approved beneficiaries of PM-Kisan
Farm land recorded in the farmer's own name in MP land records (khasra or B-1)
PM-Kisan e-KYC done, and a bank account that is Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled

Not eligible: income tax payers, serving or retired government employees (except Group D), pensioners getting Rs 10,000 or more a month, practising doctors, engineers, lawyers and CAs, and present or former MPs, MLAs and ministers
Each instalment is checked by the Patwari and approved by the Tehsildar before payment
documents: Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked for e-KYC OTP
Khasra or B-1 land record showing the land in your name
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled account
PM-Kisan registration number, if you are already registered
موبائل نمبر

demoFields.label: کس سے تلاش کریں
demoFields.hint: You can also search by bank account number or PM-Kisan ID. Aadhaar is the easiest.

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: The farmer's own 12-digit Aadhaar, the same one given for PM-Kisan.

demoFields.label: Captcha (कृपया कैप्चा डालें)
demoFields.hint: Copy the letters in the picture exactly. Reload the picture if you cannot read it.

demoFields.label: Active / Inactive (सक्रिय/निष्क्रिय)
demoFields.hint: Active means instalments will come. If it says Inactive, the next box tells you why.

demoFields.label: Reason if inactive
demoFields.hint: Common reasons are e-KYC not done, land not seeded, or a name mismatch between Aadhaar, bank and land record. Take your papers to the Patwari or tehsil office to fix it.

demoFields.label: Khasra number (खसरा क्रमांक)
demoFields.hint: Check that every piece of your land is listed. If a khasra is missing, tell the Patwari.

demoFields.label: Patwari verification date
demoFields.hint: The date the Patwari checked your land for this instalment. If it is blank, the instalment has not moved yet.

demoFields.label: Tehsildar approval date
demoFields.hint: After this date the payment order is made.

demoFields.label: Payment status and UTR number
demoFields.hint: Success with a UTR number means the money has gone to the bank account shown. Quote the UTR at the bank if it does not appear.

demoSteps: First check whether you already get PM-Kisan. If you do, you need not apply for this scheme; the state adds you automatically.
If you are not on PM-Kisan, register for it: New Farmer Registration on pmkisan.gov.in, or through the Patwari, a CSC or Lok Seva Kendra. Your land must be in your name in MP.
Complete PM-Kisan e-KYC with an Aadhaar OTP or face scan, and ask your bank to confirm the account is Aadhaar-seeded with DBT active.
The Patwari verifies your land on the SAARA system and the Tehsildar approves it.
Open saara.mp.gov.in, choose CM Kisan Kalyan Yojana beneficiary status (हितग्राही स्थिति), and search with your Aadhaar, bank account or PM-Kisan ID.
If it shows Inactive, go to the Patwari or tehsil office with Aadhaar, khasra and passbook and get the reason shown fixed.
Rs 2,000 comes into your account three times a year by DBT. The UTR number for each instalment appears on the same page.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana (Sambal Card)
schemes.department: Madhya Pradesh Asangathit Shahri evam Gramin Karmkar Kalyan Mandal, Labour Department
schemes.brief: Sambal is Madhya Pradesh's card for unorganised workers such as farm labourers, hawkers, domestic workers, tendu leaf collectors and, since 2024, gig and platform workers. A registered worker's family gets Rs 5,000 for the funeral, and Rs 2 lakh on a normal death or Rs 4 lakh on an accidental death. There is also help for disability, and Rs 16,000 maternity help for women workers. Sambal 2.0 (2022) reopened registration, including for workers rejected earlier. The card also makes the family eligible for the free Ayushman (Niramayam) card.
schemes.benefit: Rs 4 lakh accidental death, Rs 2 lakh normal death, Rs 16,000 maternity help, Rs 5,000 funeral
eligibility: Resident of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 or above, with a Samagra ID and Aadhaar e-KYC
Works in the unorganised sector (36 listed kinds of work, such as farm labour, hawking, domestic work, tendu leaf collection, gig and platform work) and gets no PF, ESI or gratuity
Not an income tax payer and not in government service
Does not hold more than 1 hectare of farm land
Death and disability help is for registered workers aged 18 to 60. Maternity help is for a registered woman worker who delivers in a government hospital, for up to two births
documents: Samagra member ID and family ID, with Aadhaar e-KYC done on Samagra
Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked for OTP
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-seeded account, with IFSC
Name, date of birth and relation of the nominee (a family member in the same Samagra)
موبائل نمبر
For maternity help later: the pregnancy (MCP) card and the hospital discharge slip

demoFields.label: Samagra ID (समग्र आई डी)
demoFields.hint: The worker's own 9-digit Samagra member number, not the family number.

demoFields.label: Family ID (परिवार आई डी)
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit family number from the same Samagra slip. Your name, age and address are then filled in from Samagra.

demoFields.label: Captcha code
demoFields.hint: Copy the letters in the box exactly, then press search.

demoFields.label: Type of work (नियोजन का प्रकार)
demoFields.hint: Pick the work you actually do for a living. Gig workers, such as delivery riders, can choose platform work.

demoFields.label: Nominee name (नामांकित व्यक्ति नाम)
demoFields.hint: The family member who will receive the money if something happens to you. Pick someone from your own Samagra family.

demoFields.label: Nominee date of birth
demoFields.hint: As in the nominee's Samagra record.

demoFields.label: Nominee gender
demoFields.hint: Choose male or female.

demoFields.label: Nominee's relation to applicant
demoFields.hint: How the nominee is related to you: wife, husband, son, daughter, mother or father.

demoFields.label: IFSC code and bank name
demoFields.hint: From the first page of your passbook. The account must be in your own name and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Account number (खाता संख्या)
demoFields.hint: Type it twice exactly. A wrong digit sends the help money back.

demoSteps: Make sure your Samagra record is e-KYC'd with Aadhaar, on samagra.gov.in or at the gram panchayat or ward office.
Open sambal.mp.gov.in and choose Apply for registration (पंजीयन हेतु आवेदन करें). Enter your Samagra ID, family ID and the captcha. The panchayat or ward office can also do this for you.
Fill in the type of work, the nominee and the bank details, then submit. Note the application number and the name of the inquiry officer shown on screen.

The inquiry officer, usually the panchayat secretary or ward in-charge, checks your details. Then the Janpad Panchayat or municipal office approves the application. Track it under Application status (संबल आवेदन की स्थिति).
Once approved, download your Sambal card from the portal. If you are rejected, you can appeal online to the SDM (पंजीयन अपील).

For maternity help, register the pregnancy at the government hospital or with the ANM. Rs 4,000 comes after the checkups and Rs 12,000 after delivery in a government hospital, straight into your bank account.

On a death, the panchayat secretary or ward in-charge pays Rs 5,000 funeral help at once. The family applies at the Janpad or municipal office for the Rs 2 lakh or Rs 4 lakh, which is paid into the nominee's account.
schemes.helpline: 0755-2700800 (Sambal helpline), CM Helpline 181

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat Niramayam (MP Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: State Health Agency (Deendayal Swasthya Suraksha Parishad), Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: Madhya Pradesh runs Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY under the name Niramayam, and the state pays for many more families than the central list covers. Every family holding an NFSA food-grain slip (khadyann parchi) qualifies, as do Sambal and construction workers, ASHA and anganwadi workers, and everyone aged 70 or above. Each family gets free, cashless treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year in empanelled government and private hospitals. You can make the card yourself on the Ayushman portal or app, or free at a Lok Seva Kendra, CSC or the hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless, in empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Families holding an NFSA food-grain eligibility slip (khadyann parchi) in Madhya Pradesh
Families in the SECC 2011 list (the central PM-JAY list)
Workers registered under Sambal or with the Building and Other Construction Workers Board, and their families
ASHA workers, anganwadi workers and helpers, PVTG families (Baiga, Bharia, Sahariya), Bhopal gas tragedy victims and Dharti Aaba (DAJGUA) beneficiaries
Every person aged 70 or above, whatever the income (Ayushman Vay Vandana card)
No limit on family size or age; illnesses you already have are covered from day one
documents: Aadhaar card of each family member who needs a card
Samagra ID and the NFSA food-grain slip or ration card
Sambal card or construction worker card, if you qualify through it
Mobile number for OTP
e-KYC کے دوران فون پر کھینچی گئی لائیو فوٹو

demoFields.hint: You can also search by family, name or PMJAY ID. If nothing comes up, check at the ration shop that your name is on the NFSA slip.

demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.hint: Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar; otherwise choose face authentication and scan the face with the phone camera.

demoFields.value: فون کے کیمرے سے کھینچی گئی

demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Check whether your family is listed: on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app, or ask at the ration shop, gram panchayat or ASHA worker. If you have an NFSA food-grain slip, you should qualify.
Log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP, choose PMJAY and Madhya Pradesh, and search for your family by Aadhaar.
Pick the member marked eKYC pending, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face scan, take the live photo, and fill in the relation, district and PIN code. Submit.
The State Health Agency usually approves within a day or two. Log in again and download the card. It is also made free at a Lok Seva Kendra, CSC, government hospital or Aapke Dwar Niramayam camp.
At the hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk with the card or Aadhaar. Treatment listed under the scheme is cashless up to Rs 5 lakh a year. Find empanelled hospitals at hem.nha.gov.in.
If any hospital asks you for money for a covered treatment, call 14555 or the CM Helpline 181.

کسی بھی فوری یا تشدد والے معاملے میں یہ پورٹل استعمال نہ کریں — 100 یا 112 پر کال کریں اور تھانے جائیں۔
schemes.helpline: ایمرجنسی کے لیے 100 یا 112؛ MP پولیس سٹیزن پورٹل کے لیے 0755-2443500

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Ladli Laxmi Yojana (Ladli Laxmi 2.0)
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: When a girl is born in Madhya Pradesh and registered under this scheme, the state issues a certificate in her name promising Rs 1,43,000 in stages. She gets scholarships when she joins classes 6, 9, 11 and 12, Rs 25,000 when she joins college, and Rs 1 lakh at age 21. The state also pays her college tuition fees. Parents should apply within one year of her birth, either online themselves or through the anganwadi.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,43,000 in stages: Rs 18,000 school scholarships, Rs 25,000 for college, Rs 1 lakh at 21
eligibility: Girl born on or after 1 January 2006 and registered at the local anganwadi centre
Parents are original residents of Madhya Pradesh and do not pay income tax
Parents have two children or fewer. The first girl qualifies without any condition. For the second girl, the mother or father must have adopted family planning after the second child
Apply within one year of the girl's birth. Late cases, orphans, adopted girls and girls who have lost a parent can be registered up to age 5 as special cases
The final Rs 1 lakh is paid only if she has appeared for the class 12 exam and was not married before 18
documents: Samagra family ID, with the girl added as a member and her 9-digit Samagra member ID
Photo of the girl with her mother or father (JPG or PNG, 40 to 200 KB)
Family planning (sterilisation) certificate, if this is the second girl
Birth certificate of the girl
Aadhaar card of the mother or father, with e-KYC done in Samagra
OTP کے لیے موبائل نمبر

demoFields.label: Case type (प्रकरण का प्रकार)
demoFields.hint: Choose Normal for a girl under one year old. Choose Special only for a delay of more than a year, an orphan or adopted girl, or a girl whose mother or father has died.

demoFields.label: موبائل نمبر
demoFields.hint: A phone you keep with you. The OTP comes here now, and the messages about approval and payments come here later.

demoFields.label: OTP
demoFields.hint: Type the code within a few minutes. If it expires, ask for a new OTP.

demoFields.label: Girl's Samagra member ID
demoFields.hint: The baby's own 9-digit number. If she has not been added to the family Samagra yet, get that done at the gram panchayat or ward office first.

demoFields.label: Family Samagra ID
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit family number printed on the Samagra slip or card.

demoFields.label: Girl's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: These come from Samagra. If anything is wrong, have Samagra corrected first, because the form takes the details from there.

demoFields.label: Anganwadi centre
demoFields.hint: The centre where the girl is registered. The anganwadi worker there checks your application.

demoFields.label: Number of children
demoFields.hint: Count all living children. If this is the second child, family planning details are needed.

demoFields.label: Family planning adopted
demoFields.hint: Needed for the second girl. Upload the certificate from the hospital where the operation was done.

demoFields.label: Photo of girl with parent
demoFields.hint: A clear photo of the baby with her mother or father. Only JPG, JPEG, PNG or GIF, between 40 KB and 200 KB.

demoSteps: Get the baby added to your family Samagra ID with e-KYC, at the gram panchayat or ward office or on samagra.gov.in, and register her at the anganwadi.
Open ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in and tap Apply (आवेदन करें). Read the eligibility, then tick the self-declarations. The anganwadi worker, a Lok Seva Kendra or an MPOnline kiosk can also do this for you.
Choose Normal case, enter your mobile number and the OTP, and tap Proceed. Fill in the Samagra IDs, check the details, upload the photo and submit. Note the application number.
The anganwadi supervisor checks the case and the Project Officer (CDPO) of Women and Child Development approves it.
Download the Rs 1,43,000 assurance certificate from the Certificate (प्रमाण पत्र) link on the home page. Keep it safely with her birth certificate.
When she joins classes 6, 9, 11 and 12, the scholarship of Rs 2,000, Rs 4,000, Rs 6,000 and Rs 6,000 is paid after the school records her admission. Keep her Samagra and bank details up to date.

After class 12, when she joins a college or professional course of at least two years, apply under the graduation incentive link (प्रोत्साहन राशि) with her Ladli registration number for Rs 25,000, paid in two halves in the first and last year. At 21 she gets Rs 1 lakh.
schemes.helpline: 0755-2700800 (portal helpdesk), CM Helpline 181

schemes.title: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY / Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra (State Health Assurance Society)
schemes.brief: Free, cashless hospital treatment for every family in Maharashtra, up to Rs.5 lakh a family each year, at government and private hospitals that have joined the scheme. Since 1 July 2024 it runs together with the central Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, so one Ayushman card works for both, and families with a white ration card, or with no ration card but a Maharashtra domicile certificate, are covered as well. It was earlier called Rajiv Gandhi Jeevandayee Arogya Yojana. There is nothing to apply for in advance: at the hospital, the Arogyamitra desk registers the patient with the ration card and Aadhaar.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at network hospitals
eligibility: Every family living in Maharashtra, whatever its income (universal cover since 1 July 2024)
Families with a yellow, Antyodaya (AAY), Annapurna, orange or white ration card
A family with no ration card is covered if it holds a Maharashtra domicile certificate
The Rs.5 lakh is shared by the whole family in a year (family floater), and illnesses you already have are covered from the first day
Covers listed surgeries and hospital treatments in 34 specialities at network hospitals in Maharashtra; in 2025 the state approved widening the list from 1,356 to 2,399 procedures
documents: Ration card of any colour (yellow, orange, white, AAY or Annapurna)
Aadhaar card of the patient
Maharashtra domicile certificate, if the family has no ration card
Mobile number for the OTP during Aadhaar e-KYC
Ayushman card, if already made (it is not needed to start treatment)
schemes.submitAt: The Arogyamitra desk at any MJPJAY network (empanelled) hospital in Maharashtra, government or private; it is usually near the main reception. Take the original ration card (or the domicile certificate) and the patient's Aadhaar card. The list of network hospitals is on jeevandayee.gov.in and is also given on the toll-free number 155388. The Ayushman card itself can be made beforehand at a CSC (Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra), through the ASHA worker, or at the same hospital desk.

demoFields.label: راشن کارڈ نمبر
demoFields.hint: The 12-digit number printed on the ration card. The Arogyamitra uses it to find your whole family in the scheme list.

demoFields.label: Ration card colour
demoFields.hint: Yellow, orange, white, AAY or Annapurna are all accepted. If you have no ration card, show the Maharashtra domicile certificate instead.

demoFields.label: Patient's name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as printed on the patient's Aadhaar card, so that the e-KYC matches.

demoFields.label: Patient's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The patient's own Aadhaar, not the head of family's. An OTP, fingerprint or face scan confirms it.

demoFields.label: خاندان کے سربراہ سے رشتہ
demoFields.hint: How the patient is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: موبائل نمبر
demoFields.hint: A number someone in the family keeps with them; messages about approval and discharge come here.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Treatment needed
demoFields.hint: The doctor writes this after examining the patient. The hospital then asks the scheme for approval of that package.

demoFields.label: Admission type
demoFields.hint: In an emergency the hospital starts treatment at once and informs the scheme by phone or email; the papers can follow.

demoSteps: When a doctor says the patient needs an operation or admission, ask whether the hospital is an MJPJAY / Ayushman network hospital. If you are not sure, call 155388 or look up the hospital list on jeevandayee.gov.in.
Go to the Arogyamitra desk with the ration card and the patient's Aadhaar. The Arogyamitra registers the patient on the scheme portal and does the Aadhaar e-KYC by OTP, fingerprint or face scan.

The doctor examines the patient, and the hospital sends a pre-authorisation request online to the State Health Assurance Society with the reports. Approval usually comes within hours; in an emergency, treatment starts first.
Once approved, the listed treatment, operation, medicines, tests, bed and food are free. Do not pay cash or sign any paper promising to pay for a listed treatment.
At discharge you receive the discharge summary. The hospital's bill goes to the government, not to you.
If a hospital asks for money for a covered treatment, call 155388 or 1800-233-2200 before paying and tell them the hospital's name.
To make the next visit quicker, get the Ayushman card made for every family member at a CSC, through the ASHA worker or at the Arogyamitra desk.
schemes.helpline: 155388 / 1800-233-2200 (MJPJAY toll-free call centre); 14555 (Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY)

schemes.title: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Niradhar Pension)
schemes.department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra (through the Tehsildar)
schemes.brief: A monthly pension of Rs.1,500 for people under 65 who have no one to support them: persons with 40% or more disability, people with serious illnesses such as cancer, TB, HIV or leprosy, widows, divorced or abandoned women, orphan children and transgender persons, among others. Disabled beneficiaries get Rs.2,500 a month from October 2025. The money comes every month by DBT into an Aadhaar-linked bank account. You apply through the talathi or the tehsil office; the state has also opened online applications on the MahaDBT portal.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 a month (Rs.2,500 for disabled beneficiaries)
eligibility: Living in Maharashtra for at least 15 years; aged 18 to below 65 (orphan or disabled children under 18 get it through a guardian)
Family income up to Rs.21,000 a year, or up to Rs.50,000 a year if the applicant is disabled; or the family is on the BPL list

Belongs to a destitute group: disabled (40% or more, UDID card needed), serious illness, widow, divorced or abandoned woman, woman whose divorce is pending, unmarried woman of 35 or more with no support, orphan child, transgender person, or the family of a farmer who died by suicide
Not drawing a regular monthly benefit from any government, semi-government or local body
At 65 the beneficiary moves to the Shravanbal or the central old-age pension
documents: Aadhaar card, and MGNREGA job card if you have one
Residence certificate from the gram panchayat or talathi, and the ration card
Age proof: birth certificate or school leaving certificate
Income certificate from the tehsildar, or BPL certificate
Proof of your category: UDID card, husband's death certificate, court divorce papers, orphan certificate, medical certificate of the illness, or transgender certificate
First page of an Aadhaar-linked bank passbook in your own name
Signed self-declaration with a passport-size photograph
schemes.submitAt: The talathi (gram mahsul adhikari) of your village, or the Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of the tehsil office; in a city, the tehsil office of your area. The prescribed application is Form 3 of Annexure 1 (page 20) of the government resolution linked here, and the tehsil office and Setu or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras also keep blank forms. Hand in two copies of the form and of each certificate, carry the originals for checking, and ask for a dated acknowledgement.

demoFields.label: To: Tehsildar, Taluka / District
demoFields.value: Tehsildar, Taluka Paithan / District Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
demoFields.hint: The tehsil where you live now.

demoFields.label: Applicant's full name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar, with husband's or father's name in the middle.

demoFields.label: پتہ
demoFields.hint: Your present address, with village or ward.

demoFields.label: تاریخ پیدائش اور عمر
demoFields.hint: You must be at least 18 and below 65.

demoFields.label: Residence in Maharashtra
demoFields.hint: At least 15 years is required. The residence certificate is the proof.

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy. The pension is paid only to an account linked with this Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Number of family members
demoFields.hint: Everyone living and eating together in the household.

demoFields.label: Total yearly family income from all sources
demoFields.hint: Add up all earnings, including support from grown sons. It must be Rs.21,000 or less (Rs.50,000 if you are disabled), as shown on the income certificate.

demoFields.label: Category of destitute
demoFields.hint: Tick one: disabled, illness, destitute woman, widow, divorced, abandoned, orphan child, transgender, family of a farmer who died by suicide.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar-linked bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name. If it is not linked with Aadhaar the money does not arrive, so check at the bank first.

demoSteps: Collect the papers first: income certificate from the tehsildar (apply at a Setu or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra), residence certificate, age proof and the proof of your category, such as the UDID card or husband's death certificate.
Get the form from the talathi, the tehsil office or a Setu kendra. Fill it in, sign or put your thumb impression in front of a witness, and attach the self-declaration with a photo.

Hand it to the talathi or at the tehsil's Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch and take the acknowledgement. The talathi visits your home to check the papers and family income and uploads a photo of the visit.

The tehsildar checks the file and places it before the Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana committee, which meets every month. The lists of approved and rejected names are put on the notice board and read in the gram sabha.
Once approved, the pension starts from the month after the online process is complete and comes by DBT into your Aadhaar-linked account every month.

Keep your Aadhaar and bank linking in order, because payments that fail for Aadhaar or bank reasons are the beneficiary's responsibility. Give the life certificate each year when the tehsil asks; if the pension stopped, giving it in the same financial year restarts it.
If nothing happens for two or three months, go to the tehsil office with your acknowledgement and ask for the committee's decision.
schemes.helpline: Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of your tehsil office; 1800-120-8040 (Aaple Sarkar helpline)

schemes.title: Shravanbal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana (Shravanbal Pension)
schemes.department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra (through the Tehsildar)
schemes.brief: A monthly pension of Rs.1,500 for poor men and women aged 65 and above in Maharashtra. If the family is not on the BPL list but earns up to Rs.21,000 a year, the whole Rs.1,500 comes from the state (Group A). If the family is on the BPL list, the person gets the central Indira Gandhi old-age pension plus a Shravanbal top-up, again Rs.1,500 in all (Group B). Each eligible person is counted separately, so husband and wife can both get it, applying with one form each at the talathi or tehsil office; the money comes monthly by DBT.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 a month per person
eligibility: Aged 65 or above
Living in Maharashtra for at least 15 years
Group A: family not on the BPL list, with yearly family income up to Rs.21,000 (Rs.50,000 if the applicant is disabled)
Group B: family on the BPL list; gets the central old-age pension with the state top-up
Not drawing a regular monthly benefit or pension from any other government scheme
documents: آدھار کارڈ
Age proof: birth certificate, school leaving certificate, or an age certificate from a government medical officer
Income certificate from the tehsildar, or BPL certificate or BPL list extract
Residence certificate from the gram panchayat or talathi, and the ration card
First page of an Aadhaar-linked bank passbook in your own name
UDID card, if the applicant is disabled
Signed self-declaration with a passport-size photograph
schemes.submitAt: The talathi (gram mahsul adhikari) of your village, or the Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of the tehsil office, which also handles Shravanbal; in a city, the tehsil office of your area. The prescribed application is Form 3 of Annexure 1 (page 20) of the government resolution linked here, the same form as for the Niradhar pension, and the tehsil office and Setu or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras keep blank forms. Hand in two copies of the form and of each certificate, carry the originals, and ask for a dated acknowledgement.

demoFields.label: To: Tehsildar, Taluka / District
demoFields.hint: The tehsil where you live now.

demoFields.label: Applicant's full name
demoFields.hint: جیسا آدھار پر ہے۔

demoFields.label: پتہ
demoFields.hint: Your present address, with village or ward.

demoFields.label: تاریخ پیدائش اور عمر
demoFields.hint: You must have completed 65. If no paper shows your age, a government medical officer can give an age certificate.

demoFields.label: Residence in Maharashtra
demoFields.hint: At least 15 years is required.

demoFields.label: آدھار نمبر
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy. The pension is paid only to an account linked with this Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Is the family below the poverty line?
demoFields.hint: Yes if the family is on the BPL list (Group B), No otherwise (Group A). The amount is the same either way.

demoFields.label: Total yearly family income from all sources
demoFields.hint: Needed for Group A. Count all earnings, including help from sons. It must be Rs.21,000 or less, as shown on the income certificate.

demoFields.label: Category of destitute
demoFields.hint: Tick elderly. Also mention a disability, if any, and attach the UDID card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar-linked bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name. Husband and wife should each give their own account.

demoSteps: Get the income certificate from the tehsildar through a Setu or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra, or a BPL certificate if the family is on the BPL list, and keep the age proof and residence certificate ready.
Get the form from the talathi, the tehsil office or a Setu kendra. Fill it in, sign or put your thumb impression in front of a witness, and attach the self-declaration with a photo.
Hand it to the talathi or at the tehsil's Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch and take the acknowledgement. The talathi visits your home to check the papers and family income.

The tehsildar places the file before the Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana committee, which also decides Shravanbal cases every month. Approved names are put on the notice board and read in the gram sabha.
The pension starts from the month after approval is complete online and comes by DBT into your Aadhaar-linked account every month.
Give the life certificate each year when the tehsil asks. If the pension stopped, giving it in the same financial year restarts it.
If nothing happens for two or three months, go to the tehsil office with your acknowledgement and ask for the committee's decision.
schemes.helpline: Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of your tehsil office; 1800-120-8040 (Aaple Sarkar helpline)

schemes.title: Lek Ladki Yojana
schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra (ICDS Commissionerate)
schemes.brief: Rs.1,01,000 in five instalments for a girl born on or after 1 April 2023 in a family with a yellow or orange ration card, paid at stages from her birth until she turns 18. It replaced the older Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree scheme. The parents apply through the anganwadi sevika, who fills in the form with them, uploads it to the scheme portal and gives a receipt. The money goes by DBT into a joint bank account of the girl and her mother.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,01,000 in 5 parts: Rs.5,000 at birth, Rs.6,000 in Class 1, Rs.7,000 in Class 6, Rs.8,000 in Class 11, Rs.75,000 at 18
eligibility: Girl born on or after 1 April 2023 to a family living in Maharashtra
The family holds a yellow or orange ration card and its yearly income is not more than Rs.1 lakh
Covers one or two daughters; if the family has a son and a daughter, the daughter gets it; twin girls at the second delivery both get it
For the 3rd instalment of the first child, or the 2nd instalment of the second child, the mother or father must give a family planning operation certificate
The bank account must be in Maharashtra; for the last Rs.75,000 the girl must be 18, unmarried and on the voter list
documents: Girl's birth certificate (register the birth with the gram panchayat or municipality first)
Income certificate from the tehsildar showing yearly family income up to Rs.1 lakh
Attested copy of the yellow or orange ration card
Aadhaar of the parents, and of the girl (not needed for the first instalment)
First page of the passbook of the joint account of the girl and her mother
Proof of residence in Maharashtra
For later instalments: school bonafide certificate, family planning certificate, and at 18 her voter ID and a self-declaration that she is unmarried
schemes.submitAt: The anganwadi sevika of your area, at the anganwadi centre. The application form is printed at the end of the scheme GR linked here (pages 9 to 12), and blank forms are also kept at every Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) office, the Zilla Parishad District Programme Officer's office and the District Women and Child Development Officer's office. Take the filled form with copies of the documents, carry the originals for checking, and ask the sevika for the signed receipt (pohoch pavti) at the bottom of the form. Apply the same way for each later instalment.

demoFields.label: Applying for (first child / second child / twins)
demoFields.hint: Tick the one that fits this girl. For twins born at the second delivery, tick twins.

demoFields.label: Beneficiary's name
demoFields.hint: The girl's name as written on her birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Beneficiary's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The girl's Aadhaar is not needed for the first instalment. Get it made before the Class 1 instalment.

demoFields.label: Parent's name (mother / father)
demoFields.hint: Usually the mother, because the money goes to the joint account of the girl and her mother.

demoFields.label: Parent's Aadhaar number and mobile
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy of this Aadhaar. Messages about the payment come to the mobile.

demoFields.label: Present address
demoFields.value: House 14, Shivaji Chowk, Malegaon BK, Tal. Baramati, Dist. Pune 413115
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now: house number, village, post office, taluka, district and PIN code.

demoFields.label: Number of living children when applying
demoFields.hint: Count all living children, sons and daughters.

demoFields.label: Joint bank account number (girl and mother)
demoFields.hint: Open a joint account in the names of the girl and her mother. If the mother has died, open it with the father and attach her death certificate.

demoFields.label: IFSC code and branch
demoFields.hint: Copy both from the first page of the passbook, and say whether the account is linked to Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Instalment applied for
demoFields.hint: Choose first to fifth. Each later instalment needs a fresh form when the girl reaches that stage.

demoSteps: Register the girl's birth at the gram panchayat or municipal office and collect the birth certificate.

Keep ready the yellow or orange ration card (attested copy), an income certificate of up to Rs.1 lakh from the tehsildar, the parents' Aadhaar and the joint account passbook of the girl and her mother.
Go to your anganwadi centre. The sevika fills in the Lek Ladki form with you, ticks the document checklist, uploads it to the portal and gives you the signed receipt. Keep that receipt.

The anganwadi supervisor checks the papers and the CDPO sends the list to the District Programme Officer of the Zilla Parishad, who approves it. If anything is missing you are told in writing within 15 days and get one month (plus 10 days) to complete it; the whole process should finish within two months.
Once approved, Rs.5,000 is credited by DBT to the joint account of the girl and her mother.

Apply again through the anganwadi with the school bonafide certificate when she enters Class 1, Class 6 and Class 11, and at 18 for the Rs.75,000 with her voter ID and a declaration that she is unmarried.
If the family moves to another district, apply for the remaining instalments to the ICDS office of the new district.
schemes.helpline: Your anganwadi sevika or the taluka CDPO office; 181 (women's helpline)

schemes.title: مہا بھولیکھ — 7/12، 8A اور پراپرٹی کارڈ
schemes.department: محکمہ ریونیو — سیٹلمنٹ کمشنر اور ڈائریکٹر آف لینڈ ریکارڈز، حکومت مہاراشٹر
schemes.brief: مہا بھولیکھ پر مہاراشٹر کے ہر گاؤں کا زمینی ریکارڈ موجود ہے — سبھی اضلاع، 716 تعلقے اور 89,000 سے زیادہ گاؤں۔ 7/12، جسے ساتبارا کہتے ہیں، بتاتا ہے کہ کھیتی کی زمین کا کوئی ٹکڑا کس کے نام ہے، کتنا ہے، اس پر کیا بویا گیا ہے اور اس پر کسی بینک کا قرض تو نہیں؛ 8A میں گاؤں میں ایک کھاتے دار کی ساری زمینیں درج ہوتی ہیں؛ پراپرٹی کارڈ سروے شدہ شہری زمین کے لیے یہی کام کرتا ہے۔ دیکھنا مفت ہے، اور ڈیجیٹل دستخط والی کاپی، جسے بینک اور دفاتر مانتے ہیں، تقریباً 15 روپے کی پڑتی ہے۔
schemes.benefit: 7/12، 8A اور پراپرٹی کارڈ مفت دیکھیں؛ ڈیجیٹل دستخط والی نقل تقریباً 15 روپے میں
eligibility: زمین مہاراشٹر میں ہو اور حقوق کے ریکارڈ (ریکارڈ آف رائٹس) میں درج ہو
کوئی بھی شخص 7/12، 8A یا پراپرٹی کارڈ دیکھ سکتا ہے — نہ لاگ اِن، نہ فیس اور نہ ملکیت کا کوئی ثبوت چاہیے

مفت پرنٹ صرف آپ کی اپنی جانکاری کے لیے ہے۔ بینک، عدالت، سبسڈی کے دعوے یا فروخت کے لیے digitalsatbara.mahabhumi.gov.in سے تقریباً 15 روپے میں ڈیجیٹل دستخط والی نقل خریدیں — دفاتر بغیر دستخط والا پرنٹ نہیں مانتے۔

اگر آپ سائٹ استعمال نہیں کر سکتے تو یہی نقلیں آپلے سرکار سیوا کیندر یا CSC پر تھوڑی فیس میں مل جاتی ہیں۔
